story.text: Mysterious, bold, radical... her quest for change is stunning.\nWith the "eye" of The Hunt, she sees all fates. Though she knows fate is immutable, the Seer Strategist still walks into danger alone.\nWith the odds stacked against her, how can she possibly change her destiny?
story.title: Character Details

story.text: One day, after the morning meeting at the Yuque's Divination Commission, the solemn silence was broken by snippets of idle gossip. "First she skips morning practice, and now she runs off to the Yuque Cup tournament!" "When I confronted her, she said only a true master of augury could be called a 'Master of Cards,' and I should play her if I didn't believe it." "And you actually played against her? Did you win?" "..." Several robes fluttered in the wind, as if holding a bellyful of grievances. "Remember last time? She gathered a few young diviners at midnight to sketch matrices, claiming she wanted to test foreign divination techniques and study their strengths. Nearly scared the elder on night patrol out of his wits." "How could I forget? She publicly challenged her teacher in class with her own invented methods of divination, infuriating him so much he complained to the Master Diviner. If the Master Diviner hadn't been so merciful, she would've been in deep trouble, genius or not..." "But still... for all her flaws, she did contribute to the formation of the 'Deca-Light Reflection Barrier.' Tell me, who else in the whole division can get the divination right with a single glance?" "Hmph, do you know what her peers call her now? 'Boss Yao,' saying man's divination is no match for heaven's will, and heaven's will is no match for her. This is nothing like Yuque's simple and austere academic style!" A simultaneous sigh washed away half their resentment, softening their tones at last. "Speaking of which, where did that girl run off to now?" A sudden song drifted in from above. A young girl straddled the rooftop wind vane, gazing up at the heavens. She flashed a bright smile: "Heads up, seniors! Master did a divination reading for me today, something about 'thunder shakes a hundred miles, yet the ritual vessels remain.' You might want to keep your distance, or you'll get struck by lightning too!" Right then, thunder instantly roared across the dome of the Yuque, deafening and fierce. Brilliant arcs of lightning unfurled, dazzling to the eye, yet horrifying to the heart. "If we can't dodge it, might as well sit back and enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime spectacle!" She knew this commotion was merely vibrations from stardust scraping against the hull as the Yuque passed through a nebula. She would be perfectly safe. Yet a small doubt still flickered in her heart: did this divination... truly come to pass? The divination reads: Thunder shakes a hundred miles, yet the ritual vessels remain.
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: In a secluded courtyard, she sat in the tranquility of the night with her junior soror who had returned home for a visit. On the simple wooden table, besides two cups of fresh tea, lay a set of divination cards for a game, seemingly veiled in a layer of long-settled dust. "Have you been to Master Jingtian's place?" "Yes, I've paid my respects." "When you left the Yuque, Master had already foreseen this day. So, you still won't consider my proposal? Look, Huaiyan has a granddaughter, Jing Yuan has a disciple. If I ever follow the same path our Master did, it'd be perfect for you to take my place~" The teacup hung in midair as the pink-haired diviner's brows furrowed slightly. "Senior soror, becoming a successor General is just a change in position. How did it manage to change your temperament too?" "Do you remember? Master used to always say: 'Sometimes there is only ever one path in destiny. Everything is predetermined.'" She focused on her cards in contemplation, as scenes from the past surfaced before her eyes. Before sending the Cloudpeer Telescope to the Fanghu, Jingtian had assigned her to guard the Yuque, ensuring the success of the plan to eliminate the Abominations of Abundance with the Reignbow's Lux Arrow. Within the Deca-Light Reflection Barrier, she had divined ceaselessly, yet never managed to grasp even a single thread of possibility that could rewrite the battle at the Fanghu. When the Reignbow's Lux Arrow fell, that inconceivable Aeonic power destroyed everything in its path, yet also forged the hope of the present. But she knew that navigating the Xianzhou through the increasingly turbulent cosmic currents would only grow more and more challenging. Beneath the jest, the Master Diviner saw the General's true intent. Perhaps in all of the Xianzhou Alliance, she alone perceived it... but she revealed nothing, merely taking a gentle sip of tea. "And what about you, senior soror? What will you leave behind for the Xianzhou Yuque?" She did not answer immediately, but instead played the card in her hand. "Well, did you see this move coming?" "Master proved himself right, but that was his legacy. As for me... I want the Xianzhou, centuries from now, to look back on what I leave behind and say..." She smiled, pondering, conviction settling in her expression. "'Who'd have expected that destiny could have a path like this too.'" — The divination reads: Though assembled in place, the will is not yet bright.
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: Volume Title: Yuque Administrative Edict Records Star Calendar Year ████ File No. Crag-██ (II) Summary: Application for Ultra-miniaturization Technology of the Jade Abacus Consultation Content: With phased progress in research on Fallow Earth traits, our academy believes focus should be placed on further miniaturization research of the jade abacus. Artisanship Commission Opinion: Regarding the Sapientia Academe's funding request for the jade abacus miniaturization research: firstly, their research direction conflicts with the Artisanship Commission's. Secondly, bypassing Commission approval and reporting directly to the General violates proper procedures. Reviewer: Yao Guang Opinion: I've reviewed the Artisanship Commission's proposal. Whose brilliant idea was it to improve performance by making the jade abacus bigger? While jade abaci are directly tied to the lifeline of the Xianzhou, we can't be overly cautious and set in our ways. Look at IPC's efficiency. Can we really afford to wait? ... Volume Title: Yuque Administrative Edict Records Star Calendar Year ████ File No. Goat-██ (III) Summary: Yuque Navigation Routes Consultation Content: The Divination Commission's divination indicates that following previous patrolling routes bring low risk and stable returns. Continued exploration along ancient routes invites numerous uncertainties. During this time of cosmic upheaval, such action may provoke calamities... Reviewer: Yao Guang Opinion: Proceed with exploration along ancient routes. The jade abacus technology wasn't developed in vain, and our improved extrapolation precision is sufficient to foresee disasters. From an interstellar trade perspective, this is enough to drive the Yuque's annual revenue to a new record high. Yet, looking at the current state of the universe, a cosmic transformation of unprecedented scale approaches, we cannot stay on the old paths. If possible, seek opportunities where the Trailblaze and Erudition converge. ... Volume Title: Xianzhou Alliance Administrative Edict Records Star Calendar Year ████ File No. Rabbit-██ (VII) Summary: Regarding the Disposition of Suspects in the Luofu "Ambrosial Arbor" Crisis Petitioner: Yao Guang Petition Content: ...The chaos Luocha and Jingliu stirred on the Luofu was likely not merely to deliver the Stellaron into the Xianzhou. According to divination through the Deca-Light Reflection Barrier, these two still harbor secrets that may sway the fate of the Xianzhou. I request they be sent to the Yuque for interrogation. If we can grasp this major variable, it might prove to be a crucial piece in achieving victory. While this is not without risk, I am willing to stake my position as the General on this... Reviewer: Hua Opinion: Approved. ... At every crossroad of destiny, her mind would return to those pivotal choices that had shaped the Yuque's current prosperity, yet also charted its course toward an alternate fate. Did her hands never tremble? She asked herself countless times. Every seemingly effortless and clever move that others saw was, on the other end, tied to the future of countless citizens of the Xianzhou. All along, she had been walking on a tightrope that could give way at any moment, but she couldn't look back, nor could she stop... Just like that near-death beginning. — The divination reads: The noble strives diligently and unceasingly, vigilant as if peril lurks within the night.
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: "Radiant heaven, morph into arrows. Celestial thunder, cleanse the flesh and bone." A voice of absolute authority, seemingly resonating through every bone in her body, echoed in the deepest recesses of consciousness. Even after enduring the Rainbow Ordainment, she still had to overcome this final trial before truly taking up the mantle and claiming the title of "General." "First Arrow, Purge Calamities!" Even in this realm of pure consciousness, her hair stood on end as an unprecedented sense of danger seared across her nerves like electricity. She focused intently on detecting its direction, muttering the verses: The "celestial thunder" struck violently, and the Barrier trembles in fright, like a planet on the brink of destruction. She barely dodged this arrow. One hair's breadth closer, and she would have been obliterated. "Second Arrow: Fell the Unbridled!" The ordeal continued relentlessly, giving no room to breathe. She drew upon every bit of knowledge she had learned to extrapolate the trajectory. Once again, she managed to dodge the arrow with perfect precision. "Third Arrow!" "Fourth Arrow!" ... "Seventh Arrow!" Like a lonely boat in a surging river, like a butterfly in a sea of thorns, the only thing keeping her from falling was her eyes that could peer into the unknown. But her spirit was gradually scattering, her steps becoming slower... As time passed, her spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak. "Eighth Arrow: Quell the Defiant!" "I can't dodge this..." She heard her own despair. So close to the summit, yet falling at the final step... Death and failure cast their shadows over her, blinding her as the merciless lightning of the Reignbow loomed above. Tilting her face to meet the descending celestial thunder, the memories of the distant past abruptly resurfaced, a divination from her Master, and that bygone day when thunder roared over fair skies. "If we can't dodge it, might as well sit back and enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime spectacle!" She heard her younger self say those words. The eighth bolt of celestial thunder struck beside her, the impact rustling her hair, but she remained unmoved. The ninth arrow never fell, and the imposing voice told her that she had passed the trial. To this day, she still does not know whether that final bolt waits somewhere in the unwritten future, ready to drop without warning. But as she departs for Planarcadia, she no longer cares. — The divination reads: From the abyss to the sky, no blame shall follow.
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: I am General Yao Guang, Seer Strategist aboard the Xianzhou Yuque. Like everyone else, you may simply call me Madam Yao. It's true, I could have divined the finer details of this encounter, but where's the fun in that? Being here in person has turned up some rather pleasant surprises.
voice.title: First Meeting

voice.text: Judging by today's weather, I'd wager you'll cross paths with the greatest mind in the entire Xianzhou Alliance... I never said that person was me, did I?
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: With skies so high and the world so wide, there's nothing that can hold you back. Next time we cross paths, I expect tales of exploits so grand they'll leave me speechless.
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: The title of "General" always comes shackled with weight and formality. "Madam" feels far freer, far lighter, wouldn't you agree? Of course, I've never cared much for formality. If you'd rather address me as "Sis"... Well, that could be fun too.
voice.title: About Self: Form of Address

voice.text: My gaze has swept across the cosmos more than once, and I've seen the fate of the cosmos rocking like a ship on the verge of being swallowed by towering waves. Still, I've never put my faith in "seeing is believing." Possibility, after all, exists for no other reason than to be defied.
voice.title: About Self: Eye of Īśvara

voice.text: Most diviners like to say "humanity's calculations are no match for heaven's plans," while the exceptional ones like to behave as if "heaven's plans are no match for my calculations." But if you ask me, all that scheming and calculating is wasted effort. Better to seize the moment yourself: clean, swift, decisive.
voice.title: About Self: Outlook

voice.text: Whether it's polishing a piece of jade or setting the heavens in motion, both demand a deft touch. That's why, no matter how busy official business gets, I still steal a moment to craft my own hand balm.
voice.title: Chat: Hand Balm

voice.text: Those of the Yuque savor sourness, as naturally as the Luofu folks cherish their tea. Lemons, pickled plums, hawthorn berries... perfect jolts for when the mind grows dull. Fancy a bite?
voice.title: Chat: Sour Things

voice.text: Back when I was studying at the Divination Commission, I may have pulled a few tricks here and there, and somehow won the Yuque Cup several years running. If others claim my divination technique lacks refinement, fine, I'll accept that critique. But call me a bad card player? Now that's just slander. Why not come see for yourself when I play Huaiyan and Feixiao next time?
voice.title: Hobbies

voice.text: There are those in the Alliance who, upon seeing the Matrix's calculations, become hesitant and indecisive. If a divination ever dares to return "This reading is unreliable," I suspect their decaying minds would simply explode on the spot.
voice.title: Annoyances

voice.text: Inspired by the extrapolations of Wisdomwalker, the Yuque constructed the Deca-Light Reflection Barrier for divining the future. A jeweled web that mirrors the world itself, its radiance multiplying without end. And thanks to a little... mishap, I once glimpsed every possible outcome through it. Heh, that so-called "variability"? That's just another word for "opportunity."
voice.title: Something to Share

voice.text: The Reignbow granted me a Spiritus known as the Kālacakra Skyplume — the "eye" of The Hunt itself. I just call it "Little Bird." Feel it watching you? Well, that's only natural. The cosmos's shining hero deserves an audience.
voice.title: Knowledge

required.missionName: The Indifference of Those Who Yet Live

voice.text: Your future does not lie within my sight, but rather beneath your own feet. As for that little secret... Well, only the heavens, the earth, and you know. I know nothing of it.
voice.title: About {NICKNAME}

voice.text: People say I'm always competing with the Divine Foresight, but little do they know we're just being honest with each other. Superficial harmony won't help the Xianzhou's development. If someone needs to play the stalwart to stir up these still waters and spark a grand competition of a hundred ships, then I'll gladly take on that role.
voice.title: About Jing Yuan

voice.text: Ah, my dear junior soror... Even when she comes to report to the Yuque, she doesn't stay a day longer than necessary, insisting on returning right on schedule. She used to love competing with me when she was little, but now her rival has become that General of the Luofu... even though I knew her first.
voice.title: About Fu Xuan

voice.text: They say foxians from the merchant guild are good at going whichever way the wind blows, but her rudder stays remarkably steady. Speaking up for the common folk, calling out the Aeons' injustice... That kind of boldness is rare, and I like it.
voice.title: About Fugue

voice.text: That girl is like a firecracker, always catching people off-guard. If she were willing to make some mischief with me... Hmm, we could definitely accomplish things no one's done before.
voice.title: About Sparxie

voice.text: She keeps her edge hidden and doesn't draw attention to herself... Even you know very little about her past, don't you? But everyone must return to where they started at some point in life, and from there, embark on a new journey.
voice.title: About Himeko

required.missionName: The Indifference of Those Who Yet Live

voice.text: A Xianzhou General roping in Penacony's former top brass? Sounds unbelievable, doesn't it? But that's exactly the kind of "unpredictable" twist I'm after. As for what surprises lie ahead... Well, we'll just have to wait and see.
voice.title: About Sunday

voice.text: Many spend their whole lives chasing their dreams, but she alone knows that "ignorance is bliss".. hey, don't laugh. That's actually an essential quality for becoming a General.
voice.title: About Qingque

voice.text: The Merlin's Claw acts as the talons of The Hunt. "Eyes" without "talons" are weak, and "talons" without "eyes" are blind. She loves hearing my ideas, and I trust her commands. Although every time she gives me fitness advice — telling me to ditch the peacock dance for the sparrow fist — she's giving me a bit too much credit.
voice.title: About Feixiao

voice.text: I don't mind her utilizing the remnants of the Propagation, burning the golden blood of the Destruction, or even borrowing the power of the Abundance itself. It's just that the picture she's painted, unfortunately, has yet to fully convince me.
voice.title: About Jingliu

voice.text: Some people's futures are like the trajectory of a bullet, never able to turn back, forever doomed to fly in a singular direction until they pierce their enemy's heart.
voice.title: About Ashveil

voice.text: Back in the day, I was good at mathematical calculations, loved having fun, and worked in intelligence... Could I have been a hacker just like her? I'd really love to face off against her in a match.
voice.title: About Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: She's got a whole trove of tall tales about the arcadia to share... But no matter how absurd they sound, considering this is Planarcadia we're talking about, I'm more than happy to nod along to every word.
voice.title: About Evanescia

voice.text: See? Planarcadia is a place where fates collide, where people fight to live through death. With what he's become, the Xianzhou now stands a better chance of victory. As for him being a former Luofu criminal... I'd say that merits and faults balance each other out, don't you think?
voice.title: About Mortenax Blade

voice.text: If you're looking to collaborate, Himeko is exactly the kind of reliable partner you want by your side. Keeping your ace in the hole until the very end... not everyone has the nerves for that. So tell me, what kind of surprises does "The Trailblaze" have in store for us next?
voice.title: About Himeko • Nova

story.text: He takes cases on a whim, cracks them with hard-core logic, and solves the strangest crimes on sheer instinct.\nWith a monkey for an assistant and his heart set on retirement, the detective sleeps in a refrigerator, waiting for the bait to catch its willing prey.\nUnder the light of the Phantasmoon, the vile beast howls. How will he draw the net on this hunt?
story.title: Character Details

story.text: Canon of Beastie Detective (I) "Dedicated to my friend, Ashveil. He has no talent for prose, so I am happy to continue serving as his 'Narrator' through this book." To outsiders, my friend is extremely eccentric. For example: 1. His pocket watch is always delayed, but he refuses to replace it①. 2. He talks in his sleep frequently②. 3. He has a habit of sleeping in the refrigerator③. 4. He enjoys being rude while others are trying to write, and even goes so far as to snatch away their feather quill... like right now. ... Due to these oddities and his total lack of deductive skill, my friend tried the following to become a "real" detective: Monday: Brought home a stack of deduction guides and studied them for five whole minutes. Tuesday: Bought clothes for disguises, but they were too garish to be of much use. Wednesday: Dressed as a gentleman to join a high-society banquet, but was kicked out for poor table etiquette. Thursday: Spent the afternoon disguised as a friendly old lady, but the police were called when he revealed his male voice while digging for info. Friday: He landed a client. His career finally seemed to be going somewhere. Saturday: Slept all day on his deduction guides. Sunday: Day off. Monday: No clients. Another day off. This endeavor ended in a total, if temporary, failure. ... Now Mr. Ashveil is the "Ashen Detective" of Planarcadia, running the most secluded detective agency in Dovebrook District and leading his loyal employees with bananas. Reflecting on the time he spent in what I call "Beastie Roleplay," he had this to say: "Don't believe a word of Mister N's nonsense. It wasn't that bad." He didn't even blink as he spoke, wearing a perfectly natural smile. It seems those experiences really did improve his acting. From this, I draw a simple conclusion: "Detective's Code, Rule 1: Act like a detective long enough, and you'll practically become one." (Notes added at my friend's request: ① Ashveil is not an idiot who doesn't know how to set a watch. ② Ashveil's sleep-talking is not funny. ③ Ashveil is a human, not a bear in hibernation.)
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: Canon of Beastie Detective (III) The great detective doesn't work alone. Take a look at the agency's group photo: The monkeys are all smiles, squeezing the detective (second row, third from the left) into the center of the frame. He gazes into the lens with an expression of blissful despair. That's the same look he wears when reviewing his bills, emptying his pockets for bananas, or seeing the utilities cut off at the end of the month. He really worries about his companions. Due to severe regression, they can't think or talk as fluently as I can. As the boss of the monkeys, he has to warn them over and over: "Archer, this city isn't a laboratory. Don't let the noise scare you, got it?" "Nana?" "Ploos might be yellow, but they're not bananas." "Nana?" "You can't eat the mechatron either, Poet. That's the second time I've told you." "..." "And that goes for you too, Musician. No more stealing snacks." "Nom nom!" He sometimes tells me their stories: how Archer lost their hands in the crossfire while covering for their companions; how the mute Poet used to be so witty; how Musician wielded a man-sized hammer to carve a path through the carnage... According to Mr. Ashveil, the "First Fang" has a duty to help every member in the pack. Those who couldn't make ends meet were all carefully relocated to star systems where they could rest and recover. With everyone pitching in, the detective agency actually managed to crack all sorts of bizarre cases that Madam Pearl threw their way over the past year, though minor hiccups like entrapment operations and aggressive interrogation tactics are... well, another story. Of all the cases he'd worked, the one that haunted him most was a revenge killing between gangs in Dovebrook. To hunt down an enemy from over a decade ago, the man sacrificed his partners, his family, his children... Yet at the end of that failed revenge, all he found was the moon's reflection dyed crimson with blood. After that case wrapped up, the detective lingered by the river for quite some time. Did he see his own reflection, too? No one knows that sometimes this detective can turn dark and unfathomable, like a whirlpool. Fortunately, he still had his daily banana budget to earn, and there are plenty of other mundane little tasks to distract him from the loneliness. "Detective's Code, Rule 2: Treasure your companions, even if they're just a bunch of monkeys."
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: Canon of Beastie Detective (VIII) Mr. Ashveil's strange affliction flares up violently from time to time. He makes everyone stay clear of the scene before we hear the violent shaking of the refrigerator, followed by sounds of tearing and gnawing, muffled howls, and sinister shadows cast upon the blinds. Once it passes, he crawls out of the refrigerator, exhausted and drained, sweeping away the blood and sweat frozen into frost, carefully reinforcing the nails on his wrists. So he often jokes: "If I were in a detective novel, I'd definitely be suspected of being the culprit." There are indeed many suspicious signs pointing to this. First, according to my incomplete statistics, Mr. Ashveil has moved countless times. Second, he always avoids meeting old friends who are looking for him. However, as his assistant, I feel obliged to clarify the truth to all readers. Mr. Ashveil is a sentimental soul who treasures mementos from ages past in his old luggage. A bloodstained bullet, even after ten Amber Eras, still carries blood that blazes with crimson fire. A rusted arrow, snapped in two yet still quivering, as if yearning to fly toward some distant destination. ... And a dim Memory Bubble, said to come from the ancient battlefield where an Overlord fell. The moment I touched the Memory Bubble, I felt like I'd lived through a similar dream... The blazing roar of Voidrangers, faint whispers of comrades freezing to the bone, and the cold fear churning in his throat. "Don't lose focus. Keep your eyes on the target." A familiar figure swallowed blood with their back turned to their comrades. Countless meteors rushed in from all directions, only to be consumed like moths by the flame of Destruction. "Will we win?" "Do all these sacrifices mean anything...?" A despair more terrifying than the surrounding darkness lingered in everyone's mind. On that brutal night, the man was pierced through by his own oath. "If we cannot find the light, then let us devour the darkness with an even deeper darkness." Shadows spread from his arms, transforming into pitch-black sin, drowning the battlefield, himself, and all his comrades alike. And from that moment on, it became a curse that clung to him like a festering wound. Truth be told, Mr. Ashveil wasn't a criminal, but a patient. And his ailments went far beyond arthritis and aching joints. But he'd already written his own prescription: "Detective's Code, Rule 3: The sacrifices made in the long night are the price paid for tomorrow."
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: Canon of Beastie Detective (Epilogue) Writing this far, I've finally pieced together some scattered fragments of the past: Before I became a primitive creature in Vonwacq's rainforests, Mr. Ashveil's name had already been appearing frequently in our conversations. "Survival rules? Do we even have that?" Robin Hood the Archer once asked me this by the campfire. "Try playing the hero, and you won't be far from becoming a real one. That's rule number one. You guys have pretty much nailed it." I said. "Don't tell me you're making these up on the spot?" Cole the Poet teased. Coria the Musician was laughing away, chomping on a steak, while the young couple Lina and Chris were singing songs they'd collected from across the cosmos. "He also said rule number two... Treasure your companions, even if they're a bunch of jerks." I said. "What about the boss of jerks? Wouldn't that make him the biggest jerk of all?" "Looking for another round of hellish training?" "Have mercy..." Robin Hood threw his hands up. "We've got a tough fight tomorrow." A moment of silence. Cole looked up at the pitch-black night sky. "Want me to write everyone's biography after all this is over?" "Make sure you include this," I patted his shoulder. "Survival rule number three: The sacrifices made in the long night are the price paid for tomorrow." "I'll remember that. How about using it as the ending?" "Let's wait till he comes up with rule number four. If he's still alive." ... Those weren't just detective tricks for cracking cases, but principles he taught us to live by. See? Even after all these years as a detective, traces of his past still linger. Therefore, I have revised the notes for section one as follows: ① He sincerely hopes the pocket watch will tick slower, as his vow of revenge remains unfulfilled. ② He often relives the past in his dreams to remember his companions who sacrificed themselves. ③ Sleeping in the refrigerator eases the phantom pain each night, as he waits for the chance to slay the monstrous beast. Perhaps all along, he's been doing the same thing, pursuing the darkness in the name of justice, until punishment rains down upon the guilty. Now, he lives because his enemies have yet to die. Ashveil is the beast that refuses to kneel before fate and races down the narrow path toward death... "Survival Rule No. 4: Chase the future along the trail of time, until you've done enough to make up for the past."
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: I am Detective Ashveil of the Ashen Detective Agency. This is my business card. I take all sorts of assignments such as looking for lost pets, pretending to be a parent in parent-teacher nights, capturing interstellar wanted criminals, or tracing the whereabouts of an Aeon... So, what can I do for you?
voice.title: First Meeting

voice.text: Sorry for the wait. A detective is never absent, just occasionally late... So, there's a new clue. Wanna hear about it?
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: After people say "see you later," most of them never come back, lost like a launched bullet. Then, how about a hug instead?
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: Number 120 in Detective Deduction 101... There! "Between a detective and their assistant, at least one of them should know a thing or two about deduction." That's why I hired Mister N at such a high rate. As for me... Doesn't matter how many alibis you've made up or how many different testimonies you've created. Come and talk to my morning star.
voice.title: About Self: Detective Agency

voice.text: People probably call me the helpful "old wolf" 'cause they see how good I am at mediating conflicts in this neighborhood. Just look, ever since I showed up, all of the street's troublemakers have suddenly learned how to behave.
voice.textReplace: People probably call me the helpful "old wolf" 'cause they see how good I am at mediating conflicts in this neighborhood. Just look, ever since I showed up, all of the street's troublemakers have suddenly learned how to behave. But this is nothing compared to training those rowdy wolf cubs back in the day.
voice.title: About Self: "Old Wolf"

unlockReplace.missionName: Real Holy Laughter!

voice.text: Which person hunting down criminals wouldn't have an enemy or two? Look at my right hand... The shadows hiding in there are debts I must eventually pay, and it aches with a phantom pain even with the prosthetic arm. But I like that kind of pain. Revenge is like a forest you can get lost in, I outran the death that clung to my heels, using the pain as a compass, a reminder of where I entered... and where I intend to exit. But this road where death never catches up, where does it finally end?

unlockReplace.missionName: Real Holy Laughter!

voice.text: How many steps does it take to place ten Amber Eras' worth of time into a fridge? Three steps, actually. Open the fridge door, shove me in, then close the door. In the end, life is just a banana that needs to be kept fresh, and mine can't expire just yet.
voice.title: Chat: Sleeping in the Fridge

voice.text: If I can retire, then I'm gonna wear a beach shirt every day, ideally coupled with a straw hat, a pair of shades, and sandals that slap the ground with every step. I'm gonna move to a tropical island to enjoy the warm breeze and watch colorful fish swim around coral reefs whenever there's nothing to do. Now THAT's what I call life.
voice.title: Chat: Attire

voice.text: Don't you think dogs are amazing? They're loyal, brave, and reliable companions that fight by your side... And their paws... So fluffy, and smelling like sunshine and soil. I want to kiss their paws every time I see them on the road.
voice.title: Hobbies

voice.text: Having no money is like having arthritis. It's never gonna go away, at least not easily. Just get used to it.
voice.title: Annoyances

voice.text: In Planarcadia, everything moves at breakneck speed. People only care about the twinkling stars above. They're forever fixated on epic tales of powerful figures battling across the cosmos, never sparing a single glimpse at some ordinary man dying alone on the cold streets. But there's no such thing as a greater or lesser injustice. Injustice is injustice.
voice.title: Share

voice.text: There's a saying in Planarcadia that any oath you swear is a curse you place upon yourself. The greater the oath is, the worse the curse gets... If that's true, then I suppose I must carry a heart big enough for the entire cosmos.
voice.title: Knowledge

voice.text: There are many big heroes in this world, but very few friends who can stay by your side. I hope you'll never be as lonely as those other heroes.
voice.title: About {NICKNAME}

voice.text: I tried to copy her and did a stream at the agency, but my stream ended up getting tags like "Trolling," "Pets," "Thrills," and "ASMR"... Maybe I should just admit that some people are born to be entertainers.
voice.title: About Sparxie

voice.text: Some things can only be revealed by gnawing at them with teeth, instead of looking at them with eyes. That little green bird pecks at people, too, when she gets worked up, doesn't she?
voice.title: About Yao Guang

voice.text: I can't smell anything wrong with her... But that's what's suspicious about her, since most people involved in these Phantasmoon Games have a complex past.
voice.title: About Kuchiba

voice.text: He came to Planarcadia to look for his leader, only to return empty-handed. Everyone said that the previous leader of the Rangers took all the money and ran away to live the good life. Silly boy... Why won't he believe that?
voice.title: About Boothill

voice.text: That girl asked me to investigate Dr. Primitive's whereabouts and left Mister N with me. She said she'll come pick him up whenever we defeat Dr. Primitive for good. By then, I'll make sure to get her to pay for all the bananas.
voice.title: About Rappa

voice.text: A student who keeps popping up at crime scenes...? That trope feels like it was ripped straight out of a mystery novel from the last Amber Era.
voice.title: About Evanescia

voice.text: Oho, now that's a cool name. Almost rivals my old handle, "Wolf King." We're both in the "hunting" business, but that relaxed vibe she has around her prey? That's something you just can't teach.
voice.title: About Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: Just as a hunter never loses their sense of smell, a master craftsman is bound to make something masterful. Still... who would've thought I'd see a miracle like this in Planarcadia of all places.
voice.title: About Mortenax Blade

voice.text: Wait, let me get this straight. You're telling me some lady's been hauling a trainload of people across the cosmos, solving world-ending crises, and doing it all without her budget ever hitting rock bottom? And now she's gone and "leveled up" on top of it? Honestly... if she wasn't standing right here in front of me, I'd have pegged it as just another tall tale.
voice.title: About Himeko • Nova

voice.text: Have the wolf howls ever ceased among the stars?
voice.title: Eidolon Activation

voice.text: See? Even a maimed old wolf can walk this far.
voice.title: Character Ascension

voice.text: Do not hesitate when it's time to bare your fangs.
voice.title: Max Level Reached

voice.text: Erase your own scent, and keep up with your prey.
voice.title: Trace Activation

voice.text: Come on. Show me what you can really do, big hero.
voice.title: Added to Team With {NICKNAME}

voice.text: Don't look at me. I don't have the money for your streams.
voice.title: Added to Team With Sparxie

voice.text: Can I get some, ah, good career fortune?
voice.title: Added to Team With Yao Guang

voice.text: Want me to do the work? Remember to pay for the bananas.
voice.title: Added to Team With Rappa

voice.text: The Rangers are getting stronger every generation.
voice.title: Added to Team With Boothill

voice.text: Looks like you've been holding out on us, little lady.
voice.title: Added to Team With Evanescia

voice.text: Whew... That reward's very tempting.
voice.title: Added to Team With Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: So many years have passed... your forging skill is now godlike.
voice.title: Added to Team With Mortenax Blade

voice.text: Navigator, how about a little post-battle exchange? I'd love to pick your brain.
voice.title: Added to Team With Himeko • Nova

voice.text: This old wolf hasn't lost all his fangs yet.
voice.title: Battle Begins: Weakness Break

voice.text: Are they asking to be beaten up?
voice.title: Combat Begins: Danger Alert

voice.text: My gut says you're shady.
voice.title: Turn Begins 1

voice.text: My job... is to be nosy.
voice.title: Turn Begins 2

voice.text: Got a way to make the prey lower their guard?
voice.title: Turn Idling

voice.text: Go cry wolf.
voice.title: Basic ATK

voice.text: Sins must be paid, eye for eye.
voice.title: Follow-Up ATK 1

voice.text: Go, and fight to the death.
voice.title: Follow-Up ATK 2

voice.text: Riddled with holes.
voice.title: Skill 1

voice.text: I... see through you.
voice.title: Skill 2

voice.text: Oh! You've learned.

voice.text: That's savage.
voice.title: Hit by Heavy Attack

voice.text: I offer my blood to consume this injustice...
voice.title: Ultimate: Activate

voice.text: Beasts, come... and slaughter each other!
voice.title: Ultimate: Unleash

voice.text: My... bright stars...
voice.title: Downed

voice.text: Wanna learn this survival trick?
voice.title: Return to Battle

voice.text: Ahh... I've missed this warmth.
voice.title: Health Recovery

voice.text: Trying to trick me?
voice.title: Technique

voice.text: Peaceful days really are hard to come by.
voice.title: Battle Won

voice.text: Pay's still pay, no matter how little.
voice.title: Treasure Opening 1

voice.text: Quit while you're ahead. Don't get greedy.
voice.title: Treasure Opening 2

voice.text: Live long enough, and things will start falling into your lap.

voice.text: They don't call me detective for nothing.

voice.text: Have I... reached the age where I actually enjoy brain-teasers?

voice.text: Are they here for revenge as well?

story.text: One season the Phantasmoon waxes full, one season the mortal world shifts anew: The mysterious girl reappears in Planarcadia!\nFallen petals scatter with ease, and her stay was but a fleeting instant. Everything about this new era enthralls her, and she will not allow anyone to bring it to ruin...\nA single ruler blade judges right from wrong, but who can say how much good or evil lies within oneself?
story.title: Character Details

story.text: At first, the ancient tree in the hidden courtyard simply listened in solitude. It heard its gnarled roots spreading beneath the earth, heard its lush branches unfurling in the wind, heard infinite life surging into the newborn world, only to fall back upon the nameless land. It paid little mind. To it, these lives were but fleeting visitors who would wither and bloom in an instant, like raindrops returning to the soil. But the Nameless Place never returned to silence. Visitors from beyond the sky and travelers from distant lands paused here, by chance or by fate. The tremors carried through branch and leaf grew ever stronger, and even without looking upon them directly, their voices traveled along the tangled roots. They gave the land a name and called it home. They thanked it, through ancient games and rituals that sealed death and the wilderness forever within the abyss. In those beautiful legends, when the moon was full, the spirit of the sacred tree would take the shape of a mischievous maiden, and visit the dreams of the devout to grant their wishes. Through these repeating rites, it began to wonder: What is laughter? What is sorrow? Why do people sing? Why do they weep? Why do some leave and never return? And why do younger lives always appear, stubbornly taking their roots here? Then, calamity slammed down from beyond the sky, and Destruction swept away all life on this land in a devastating wave. It saw their tears and heard their cries, watching as what once grew from nothing, returned to nothing. As it watched, a storm brewed deep inside it. At last, it came to understand laughter and tears. Why people sang and wept. And why they could never return. Tonight, they would continue singing to it. Tomorrow, they would fight to the death. This they declared with great courage. A mother held up her child to string its branch with red thread for a blessing. The child stared at it through clear eyes that had no concept of fear. Smiling, and with a tiny hand made nearly translucent by the firelight, she reached out to a branch... "Pinky promise, Miss Sacred Tree..." At that moment, countless destinies coalesced into a vibrant ink that paints her into the mortal realm. In the next instant, two palms — one large, one small — gently pressed together. And so, under the moonlight, the girl named "Evanescia" stepped into the mortal world.
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: "This morning I opened my eyes to a new vista. There is a round, golden thing called an egg tart. And this curio is called a handheld console. From the screen you see and hear people in it. Fun little thing, I miss it greatly if I stop playing for even a moment. The Phantasmoon Etiquette ended unbearably early..." — Notes on Life in Ahatopia (II) "A device for communicating across thousands of miles is called a 'phone.' Ritual performers are called 'idols.' Short-sleeved shirts are called 't-shirts.' Jokes are called 'memes.' Companions are called 'besties' or 'bros,' and 'I'm psyched!' means you are ecstatic... I completely understand now! ... This time I'm cosplaying as a high school girl! But I can't have people thinking I'm a fossil, so first things first, a new outfit and cute weapon skin! Thanks to my bestie, I'm also now giving trendy! What was my life before comics!? Now I'm all like: So hype! So cute! This is my vibe! Ugh, there's way too many unruly Supplicants, and I haven't even finished reading. I'll live to see this story end... right!?" — Notes on Life in Planarcadia (VIII) "Fam, I'm living the dream! First time at a con today, first time cosplaying. I'm in my favorite character's outfit, wig on, makeup done, standing in front of the mirror... is that really me? Ever since the IPC came to this place, there's been something new and wild every single day, memes popping up left and right — I can't even keep up with them if I pulled an all-nighter cramming them! But everyone's tolerance to jokes are getting better and better, and putting on bigger shows. Supplicants are pulling out all the stops for views. I rescued those kidnapped children, but I couldn't use Abundance to heal them... If I lost control, it would've caused an even worse disaster... *sigh* Listening to their hearts stop beating, sometimes I wonder why I'm even here, why this land is cursed with such misfortune..." — Notes on Life in Planarcadia (XVI) The young girl doesn't gaze down upon the mortal realm from above Phantasmoon. Instead, she's more interested in mingling with the mortals. Humans are such fascinating creatures. They imagine, they wish, they pray, they curse. Either way, she has only one mission in the Master of Elation's Phantasmoon Games: see them through to the end— But the joy and sorrow, fear and dread she has touched... do they really drift away with the wind? Even before the moment of her perception, she has already been shaped by everything she has felt.
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: Sixty seconds on the clock, a minute until words vanish completely. When the victor of this Phantasmoon Games announced this miracle, most people just dismissed it as a farce. They looked up, ready to witness this folly. 59 seconds left. Epic, action-packed comic book battle lines spill from the pages. "We quit! You come up with your own battle sounds!" The people of Planarcadia burst out laughing. 50 seconds left. The escaped words are reborn. They sprout limbs, gaining meaning beyond mere symbols— The word "Blade" races, glinting through the streets. The "Spear" and "Bullet" join forces, becoming indiscriminate killers tearing across the roads. Libraries, home bookshelves, coffee shops... An endless torrent of words comes flooding in, with nowhere to hide. And still, even more terrifying words are breaking free from their shells. 40 seconds left. Anguished screaming and wailing echoes throughout Planarcadia. The "Demon King of the Century," the "Master of Destruction," the "Sisters of Reticence"... Born from the entertainment industry's books, they feed on people's terror. They take the form of devils hovering above Planarcadia, directing this apocalyptic Euphoria. 30 seconds left. As all the Code sneak away, digital devices go dark, Planarcadia's defensive facilities shut down completely, security officers fall in great numbers. 20 seconds left. The girl fighting on all fronts halted, staring at the human world turned into purgatory. She seems to have come to a decision. 10 seconds left. A flash of extraordinary radiance. The Ambrosial Arbor in the courtyard lowered its endless branches from the void and grabbed the rampaging word monsters. 5 seconds left. A cool smile plays on the girl's face as she watches the branches drain the life from the words, leaving them floating like withered leaves. 3 seconds left. A crimson blade flashes through the air, severing the symbols. Afterward, the severed symbols are then woven into a reborn language for future generations. A minute later, the Phantasmoon Games resumed normally. But the world appears aged, yellowed. The earth cracked open, mountains and valleys diminished into dust, and a sorrowful girl fell from the sky.
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: The Phantasmoon dims, and she drifts back into the embrace of dreams. In those endless dreams, fragments both strange and familiar rise then settle. She dreamed of a single tear. A ceaseless tune rang in her ears, its melody swaying her as she lamented her dying kin. No matter how hard she tried to save them, they relentlessly peaked at youth, froze, and plummeted into old age. Their tears falling on her hands were searing. She dreamed once again of gloriously marching to war. Her kin had come to call her the "Swordsinger." The blade to cut through all obstacles, the song to comfort her people. She vowed to overturn their fate and bless them with eternal life. She was tireless on her quest for the elixir. Yet behind her hurried steps, death followed like a shadow. Using life itself as fuel, the slender hands tending the mystical garden finally extended toward her a branch of favor. Memories of life and death stirred her awake once more. Driven by unmatched pride, she had charged thoughtlessly into the forbidden territory of the Alliance Fleet. Only afterward did she consider how effortlessly the opponent in front of her could parry her sword. Like dry leaves faced with encroaching wildfire, she too was at a loss in front of this blaze. When she lost by the slimmest of margins, her other self mocks: "Why resist what you truly are?" She saw a giant tree, eternally immortal even as its surroundings were devoured and reduced to nothing but piles of bleached bones. Yet before the Dreamscape could murmur its reply, she had already broken free of its unending embrace. She heard clamoring beyond the courtyard, a noise that chased away the terror born of deathly silence. Seated upon the golden treetop, once more, she reached out her hand toward the mortal world: "Is that even a question? If I turned into something like you, how could I keep up with Fluffy Across the Blue's latest updates!?"
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: Congrats, you've hit the jackpot! I'm Evanescia. Nice to meet you, Main Character Little Raccoon. Usually, amidst all this revelry, I just make sure the Phantasmoon Games run smoothly... But this time? Sharing the stage with you doesn't sound half bad!
voice.title: First Meeting

voice.text: Did a new issue of The Fluffy drop today? Nope!
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: Fate works in mysterious ways, doesn't it? Maybe someday, we'll meet again on a street where flower petals dance in the air... I'm looking forward to it.
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: A long time ago, people would whisper their deepest secrets to the Ambrosial Arbor that fell into Planarcadia, tying red strings of prayer to its branches... Thanks to the masks of The Laughter, the Wishpower of the mortal realm imagenated me into who I am now: the Guardian of the Phantasmoon Games. To be honest, sometimes even I am afraid of my own power, but isn't that how it always goes in comics? You've gotta conquer your dark past to experience true growth~
voice.title: About Self: Past

voice.text: I came up with the name myself. What do you think? Doesn't it have a nice ring to it? Evanescia, Evanescia... It's just like that moment when something beautiful is in full bloom. Even if it's fleeting, it becomes eternal in your heart.
voice.title: About Self: "Evanescia"

voice.text: Measuring the fleeting splendor of ages, adjudicating the boundary of truth and falsehood. When the blade is sheathed, neither gods nor ghosts shall be spared... Heheh, pretty cool line, right? If anyone dares disrespect the rules of the Phantasmoon Games, I'll make sure they get a taste of my ruler.
voice.title: Chat: The Ruler of Judgment

voice.text: I'm actually incredibly gifted when it comes to the way of the brush. Just look at that raccoon mask I gave you... The strokes are wild and free, the lines abstract and evocative. This is what I call... reaching the pinnacle of artistry and returning to simplicity!
voice.title: Chat: Painting

voice.text: Every time the Phantasmoon Games come around, this is my go-to show for keeping up with all the latest trends in Planarcadia. Sure, the outside world's constantly evolving, but those painfully awkward, laugh-till-you-cry moments? Still the same as ever. That's the magic of it.
voice.title: Chat: Humanity's Most Baffling Behaviors

voice.text: Whether it's Woof Woof Dan ripping through Phanty's shoulder, March Bunny taking down Titans with a single punch, or the Baseball Raccoon riding a rolling trashcan to battle the Singing Septimus... I'm here for it all! Why are you making that face...? Am I remembering it wrong?
voice.title: Chat: Fluffy Across the Blue

voice.text: With Star Rail FEST being all the rage lately, I really want to cosplay something, but I'm completely torn because there are just too many characters I love... My top choice is definitely March Bunny since I can use my real hair, but playing Woof Woof Dan sounds kinda tempting too, you know?
voice.title: Hobbies: Role-Playing

voice.text: Back in the day, it was the national pastime that took Planarcadia by storm. Everyone had a copy. It's been so long. Who could've imagined that the tiny Master Fox would turn into my trusty assistant? Come on out and say hi to {NICKNAME}~
voice.title: Hobbies: Digital Pet Egg

voice.text: Whether it's a fuzzy spider or a shiny beetle, if one lands on me, I will personally demonstrate how to rip a bug apart with your bare hands! And some comic artists just love those giant-insect-themed imagenae. It's the stuff of nightmares... I'm getting goosebumps just talking about it.
voice.title: Annoyances 1

voice.text: You finally catch up on a comic series, only to find out it's been axed... Couldn't they just put it on hiatus instead? As long as the artist is still breathing, miracles can happen...
voice.title: Annoyances 2

voice.text: I can only manifest in the physical world while the Phantasmoon Games are happening. Do you have any idea the kind of suffering involved in trying to binge over a decade's worth of fun and entertainment in just a dozen days? Compared to that, hunting down merch from across the cosmos is practically nothing... Enough said, just call me the master of time management!
voice.title: Something to Share

voice.text: In the beginning, the people of Planarcadia held ceremonies to entertain the gods and cast out evil, all to suppress the wickedness beneath the earth. Over time, the format changed, and people gradually forgot its original purpose. The Phantasmoon Games eventually turned into something more like a stage play... Don't get me wrong, I prefer it this way. Those nightmarish days should never return.
voice.title: Knowledge: Phantasmoon Games

voice.text: Being able to respond to the kind-hearted hopes among all the malicious wishes, and become a hero protecting Elation in Planarcadia... Only our Baseball Raccoon could do it.
voice.title: About {NICKNAME}

voice.text: She said I'd be the perfect fit for promoting headphones on stream. If I did a livestream, it would take Planarcadia by storm for sure... What a shame. If I weren't so pressed for time, I'd definitely want to give it a shot.
voice.title: About Sparxie

voice.text: I really want to go play claw machines, scratch lottery tickets, and pull for characters with her... I'm not just saying things! Even if you don't believe in Aha, you have to believe in Yao Guang's luck!
voice.title: About Yao Guang

voice.text: On the surface, a washed-up detective with nothing to his name. Underneath, a renowned Ranger hero... Sounds straight out of a comic book, right? Planarcadia is exactly the kind of place where the unexpected is always possible.
voice.title: About Ashveil

voice.text: I can't believe she's a die-hard fan of Planarcadia's first video game! You know that feeling of pure joy when you finally meet someone who just gets it? When it comes to gaming, I will always pledge my allegiance to Lady Silver Wolf!
voice.title: About Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: Sealing the undying Abundance within his own body... I have to admit, that's a rather novel approach.
voice.title: About Mortenax Blade

voice.text: Fate truly works in mysterious ways. Back then, she was just a girl gazing at the stars, beginning her own little Fluffy Across the Blue. Now, she's returned like a hero straight out of a comic to save her home. I suppose it's true after all, nothing gets my heart racing quite like the triumph of the human spirit!
voice.title: About Himeko • Nova

voice.text: A flutter of petals, and a bond eternal~
voice.title: Eidolon Activation

voice.text: Seal removed! Feast your eyes on my legendary blade!
voice.title: Character Ascension

voice.text: I can finally unleash that move!
voice.title: Max Level Reached

voice.text: Walking, laughing, crying... just another day in the life~
voice.title: Trace Activation

voice.text: The fifteen-year wait is over! The Ruler-Blade Fox humbly welcomes the Baseball Raccoon back to their rightful throne!
voice.title: Added to Team With {NICKNAME}

voice.text: Hey Sparxie, streamer-to-streamer tip: Don't let those sparks burn too bright!
voice.title: Added to Team With Sparxie

voice.text: One more time! Can you see through my fate, now?
voice.title: Added to Team With Yao Guang

voice.text: O Great Detective... Can you deduce who I am this time?
voice.title: Added to Team With Ashveil

voice.text: Carry me, big shot! Let's team up and grind some points!
voice.title: Added to Team With Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: If you think about it, aren't we the bigger threat?
voice.title: Added to Team With Mortenax Blade

voice.text: Piloting a giant robot with Himekat? This has to be a dream!
voice.title: Added to Team With Himeko • Nova

voice.text: The pinker the hair, the harder they hit... Haven't you heard?
voice.title: Battle Begins: Weakness Break

voice.text: Classic villain entrance, right on cue~
voice.title: Battle Begins: Danger Alert

voice.text: Let me measure that... Whoa, you're WAY over the limit!
voice.title: Turn Begins 1

voice.text: You seriously thought I was just a mascot?
voice.title: Turn Begins 2

voice.text: Hesitation means defeat, you know?
voice.title: Turn Idling

voice.text: You're it.
voice.title: Basic ATK

voice.text: See you later, everyone!
voice.title: Skill 1

voice.text: By the Phantasmoon I'll vanquish you!
voice.title: Skill 2

voice.text: You done playing yet?
voice.title: Hit by Light Attack

voice.text: Tall trees attract the wind...
voice.title: Hit by Heavy Attack

voice.text: You've stepped out of line~
voice.title: Elation Skill 1

voice.text: The game is fixed~
voice.title: Elation Skill 2

voice.text: Do your worst, Master Fox.
voice.title: Ultimate: Activate

voice.text: I decide the rules of the game... And you're out!
voice.title: Ultimate: Unleash

voice.text: Time's not up yet...
voice.title: Downed

voice.text: The story's not finished.
voice.title: Return to Battle

voice.text: I've been healed, awesome!
voice.title: Health Recovery

voice.text: Release the confetti~
voice.title: Battle Won

voice.text: I get it now! You set up a surprise for me, didn't you?
voice.title: Treasure Opening 1

voice.text: Could it be... plot armor?
voice.title: Treasure Opening 2

voice.text: My wish? To collect every last Stellar Jade~
voice.title: Precious Treasure Opening

voice.text: See? I told you comics can teach you useful things.
voice.title: Successful Puzzle-Solving 1

voice.text: The way the Nameless think is truly fascinating...
voice.title: Successful Puzzle-Solving 2

voice.text: Based on combat analysis... This guy's tough!
voice.title: Enemy Target Found

voice.text: Let me see what's trending today...
voice.title: Returning to Town

voice.text: Petals fall without a trace.

story.text: A new season of Elation begins, featuring the limited-time return of the invincible player "Silver Wolf LV.999"!\nShe's conquered the universe, unlocked every cosmic achievement... What's left to play?\n"Reach the peak of 'Elation'? Boring... Since I've got the cartridge now, I make the rules~"
story.title: Character Details

story.text: >>>"I'll join." >>>And just like that, the game called "Punklorde" ended that day. >>>Admin "ID: Elio" granted access. >>>"ID: Silver Wolf" has joined the "Stellaron Hunters" faction, logging into the game "Cosmos." "Companion System" The girl used to be a lone wolf, but now she's got a few co-op allies: a lady with a 10.899 billion bounty on her head, and a guy and mech whose bounties are valued at 8.13 and 9.723 billion respectively. "You all look pretty solid. Just don't drag me down." She huffs and tosses a console each to all three. "Wanna play a round?" "Faction Buff" Mastermind? Laughter's mischief? "Come on. I don't mind being painted as the mastermind. Makes the game experience way more fun." With enemy fire raining down from behind, she snapped her fingers, and Silver Wolf's graffiti plastered itself all over the latest wanted posters. "Now try forgetting that. From now on, anytime someone mentions the Stellaron Hunters, they're immediately gonna think of Silver Wolf." "Main Missions" Administrator "ID: Elio" sets goals for the Hunters but doesn't restrict how they achieve them. In those worlds ravaged by Stellarons, she witnessed her allies' special abilities. "Toying with prey? Too elegant. I'm not that classy." "Can't die? No catch?" "Armor's here...I need a better-looking new set to play with too." She calls out to Elio, frustration in her voice: "Hey, everyone else gets all these perks, so why do I have to start the mission from scratch?" "WARNING" Warning! Stellaron Hunters collection storage has been breached! Warning! Top secret classified item, "Silver Wolf LV.999" Aether Cartridge has been stolen! "How can I steal something that was mine in the first place? Leaving!" The girl makes a face at the camera. Warning! Unauthorized use of the "Silver Wolf LV.999" Cartridge will result in unpredictable consequences! "As if... Just see how many ways of gameplay I can unlock with this!" >>>"ID: Silver Wolf" has logged out of "Cosmos" >>>"ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" has logged in to "Cosmos" >>>Warning! Warning! Warning! >>>"Script" detected █████
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: "Backstage Paintball" was the first thing that came to her mind. You toss a ball into the screen here, and it flies out from another screen halfway across the cosmos. If a bunch of Masked Fools dared to feed her false intel and run their mouths... "Come at me through the internet if you've got the guts." ...she'd be more than happy to oblige their wish. That bomb could blow their local tavern sky-high. The "Formatting Gun" breaks down everything it touches into pixels, triggering a "shot" that formats all data. "If I want to uncover the true face of the Pure Child of Anāsrava, I'll need to be able to get out of the Garden of Recollection in one piece..." The girl imagined herself sneaking into the Garden, searching for clues... "I might as well format the Memokeepers' memories too! They'll definitely be standing there stunned, watching me slip away like I'm a total stranger!" "Greedy Snake," a curio modeled after the leviathan "Voracity." Originally shaped like a snake, but the more it eats, the more it transforms into a donut. She forgot it on top of a volcano, but two system hours later, she spotted it immediately... Because the volcano was gone. The detention room door swung open, revealing a woman leaning against the door frame, gazing helplessly at the graffiti covering every inch of the walls. "Playtime's over, Silver Wolf." The girl tossed aside her marker with boredom. "I've already figured out what I'm doing next time. You can't keep me locked up." "Do you have any idea how much chaos you caused messing around with that cartridge?" "Oh, I remember." A sly grin spread across the girl's face. "You mean how the Cosmic Big Lotto spit out a million jackpots and Oswaldo himself had to shut the whole thing down?" "Or wait, are you talking about when the Harmonic Strings hit three wrong notes in a row? Totally unprecedented." "You're not still on about Screwllum, are you? That was all fake. I didn't actually disassemble him into spare parts, okay? And even if I did, it's not like I'm scared of him getting payback." The woman shook her head. "I'm talking about you. You nearly didn't make it. That cartridge was controlling you." The girl turned her head away. "Don't need you worrying about me... Next time, I'll just come up with some new tricks." >>> "ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" has logged out of "Cosmos" >>> "ID: Silver Wolf" has logged in to "Cosmos"
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: The girl has an "achievement wall," on which she awards herself a digital badge every time she hits a goal. By now, her achievements are too numerous to count... Achievement: "Solo Maxxing" Description: Become a living LEGEND in Punklorde Status: Completed Player Review: "For me, the hardest part wasn't surviving. It was staying in Punklorde and getting stuck in place." Achievement: "Friend of the IPC" Description: Evenly distribute the IPC's virtual currency among all "Star Cheetah" players Status: Completed Player Review: "They're pinning their year-end accounting discrepancies on us again. 'All for the Amber Lord' they say. More like 'Blame it all on the Stellaron Hunters.' Fine, have it your way. While I'm at it, might as well leak all their dirty laundry too... Hope they raise my bounty even higher." Achievement: "Even Bladie Would Disapprove This" Description: Tank all the attacks from the cyberdemons in Jepella, the city of sins Status: Completed Player Review: "That time in Jepella, I left behind a super cool line in the sky: 'City of sins, I absolve you from being guilty.'" Achievement: "What a Genius" Description: Engage in an information battle against a Genius and obtain an ASSS rating. Status: Completed Player Review: "Is Screwllum a sore loser or what? Using admin privileges to force-disconnect me? Talk about playing dirty!" ... The girl kept smashing her own records, yet at the end of that achievement wall, one badge remained unlit. Engraved on it was a figure similar to her own, but far more flamboyant. It was the vision of some possible future, standing at the peak of Elation, having reached the absolute limit: "Silver Wolf LV.999..." Achievement: "GAME NOT OVER" Status: Incomplete Description: Break through the LV.999 limit and keep this game going forever.
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: "First off, as a diehard veteran player of 'αWolf,' let me roast the previous game's producer ...Aha's just an Aeon of Elation who doesn't know jack about making games. Forcing me to start with a brutal opening like "Wandering Orphan," grinding experience with that starter cartridge? Talk about a slog! Would it kill you to let me have some fun? Once I survived the opening, things got way better. Becoming the overlord of the Dark Zone Empire, recruiting the Rangers and taverns, and becoming the new master of Device IX, pretty cool stuff. But then the game just... ends? Seriously? What a cop-out! Good thing I knew about your level cap setting, LV.999. Otherwise, making me fight someone who looks exactly like me, and every attack she makes is like saying "Tired. I am so done..." Do you have ANY idea how terrifying that is!? Anyway, back to business! "αWolf Online," which I've been working on for ages, is finally ready to meet you all. To address the pain points mentioned above, I've made the following improvements: 1. Massive Time-Saver! No Grind Required, Level up with One Click Just complete the Stellaron Hunter bootcamp, and you'll unlock the latest form with a single click, gaining brand-new powerful items. Trust me, it'll carry you to victory! 2. New Feature! Experience the Story Your Way When Elation arrives, even the script has to step aside. Play however you want, whenever you want. 3. New Mode! Face a challenge without limit in the Infinite DLC Say goodbye to boring grinding. The best part of the game is always ahead. Hit LV.999? So what? Beyond the peak of Elation, there's an even higher summit waiting. Aha, see that? Now THIS is what a next-gen game looks like. But by choosing αWolf Online, you've chosen "Nightmare Mode." A one-life clear is just the baseline. And every boss is different from the last. So, you're probably wondering: What happens when you fail? Of course, the odds of that happening are basically zero. But if it does, I hope everyone playing this game remembers: This cartridge chronicles an unprecedented hacker's journey. Reaching the end is important, but having more fun along the way is even more important! Next up, get ready for the grand opening of αWolf Online! To all you folks watching, I wish you joy, and I wish myself a blast!" — Message from developer Silver Wolf >>> Administrator "ID: Elio" has granted LV.999 cartridge permissions. >>> "Phantasmoon Games" raid loading... >>> "Script" temporarily disabled. >>> "ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" logging into "Phantasmoon Games"...

story.text: His body is like springwood. His heart is like dead ash. Yet still, a craftsman's spark cling to his fingertips.\nAncient grudges flare anew. He vows to send both himself and that God over to the other shore.\nThis body torn asunder, yet holding fast through a thousand temperings into a blade... What answer will it forge?
story.title: Character Details

story.text: He still remembered those early days in the Zhuming, gazing up at the endless shelves of forging manuals, the armory's display of divine weapons stretching out like an endless sea. As a mayfly never sees the night, a cicada knows nothing of spring and autumn. For the first time in his life, he truly understood how small a man could be next to the ages. With the short lifespan of his kind, he'd be lucky to even scratch the surface of the forging art. He could only start from scraps, filling the crumbling smelting furnace with coal slag. He failed. That sword seemed flawless and sharp beyond measure, yet shattered into pieces when he flicked his finger to test it. "A useless blade..."Burning with shame, he hid it away. What he didn't see was his white-haired master running a finger across that broken sword, nor the thin red line of blood it left on his fingertip. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft. Good." He remembered the shackles he forged for the Ten-Lords Commission. "Forging a blade is like tempering the soul. The real skill is making the simplest thing well." He didn't understand. If his skills were already exceptional, why did his master make him start from being an apprentice? But he never argued. He believed in the general's words, just as he believed that a true gem never stays buried for long. His fellow disciples came, the Flamewheel Octet came, Huaiyan came. They all watched him, laboring day and night without rest in the Forge. Until the flames finally died out, and they laid eyes on the most fearsome shackles of their lives. The cold gleam of those manacles was muted, but their menace weighed on one like a mountain. No one could have imagined that years later, the imprisoned Borisin Warhead would spend long, long years locked up in chains cut from the same cloth. He remembered the trial for Furnace Master. But for a short-life species to be chosen as the chief craftsman of the Zhuming, that was unprecedented. He'd prepared himself well. But when the smelting began, he found that all his materials had been swapped for rotten scrap. He just smiled. A day and a night later, he unveiled a delicate, ingenious mechanical lion, a creation that put any treasure-forged contraption to shame. He remembered how before being granted the title "Furnace Master," his master repeated that simplest of questions— "What makes a blade?" He'd never once hesitated in his answer. That was the peerless weapon he was meant to forge, the one that would leave every other blade in the dust. Yet when these distant memories resurface, all he could hear was the mournful howls of shattered blades.
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: He joined the Stellaron Hunters to seek the ultimate "salvation"... At least, that's what the Hunters promised. Clink, clank, bullet casings clattered to the ground, like some kind of melody. "Oh no, I'm all out of bullets." The lady raised both hands, eyes darting toward the sky. The night was silent. Then a pillar of light pierced the heavens, hurtling toward the hunters. The madman charged straight into it. The high-energy beam nearly tore him apart. No, clearly not. His flesh was like rampant spring ivy, knitting itself back together in the blink of an eye. "Stop testing my loyalty! If I find out your promises were nothing but lies, I'll be the first to put a blade through you!" "Listen to me, Bladie. As long as you don't want it, no one can make you bleed." The Antimatter Legion before her eyes was torn to shreds by a dark figure. A silver mech punched what few Voidrangers remained into dust, then turned to watch, helpless, as one man danced alone against an army. "Remember, Sam, whatever you do, don't get caught in his sword formation." She recalled Kafka's parting words before the mission. And now, staring at the gruesome wreckage before her, she understood what it meant to be a blade— He was the sharpest "Blade" of the Stellaron Hunters. Clink, clang, the snow came down all night, so thick it nearly buried the camp whole. The silver-haired girl stepped out of her tent and found him still sitting cross-legged, sword laid across his knees. "Get some rest. I'll take watch tonight." "No need. I'm used to it." "Hmph. Weirdo." She watched as snow piled up on his shoulders, as if it had turned his hair white. A deep chill suddenly washed over her. She understood then. There were some people in this world who could only find a moment's peace on these barren, empty snowfields.
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: Chaos. Darkness. The belly of the beast from the dawn of the universe seemed ready to dissolve everything. He'd thought himself numb to pain long ago, but now an invisible struggle threatened to tear his soul to shreds. Petty whispers chattered on and on inside his head, step by step, coaxing him toward the abyss of ruin. "Why resist? I can grant you the power to reforge life and death itself, to undo all your regrets!" Undo all regrets... He thought of Master Huaiyan, the disappointment in his eyes. He thought of the five of them, once so full of promise. He thought of the ending he should have had... No. Not that. Never that. Not once, not ever. This was nothing but escape, cowardice, surrender... Just like those years spent rotting in regret. Just like this aimless, half-dead existence, wandering from day to day with nothing but the wish to die. That wasn't how his "script" was supposed to "end." "Stellaron Hunters exist to rewrite Finality, and to rewrite their own endings." In the "Finality" Elio revealed, he glimpsed a sea of spider lilies scattered with bones, a boundless beast skewered through, and a furnace belching flames. Black hair turned white as snow, and the aged artisan could finally embrace death. Yet the root of the immortality calamity had already bloomed anew elsewhere... He still has a chance to change it all. "Yingxing, are you really so bent on dragging us both into the abyss!? All you'll gain is endless suffering, torn between life and death!" He didn't hear Shuhu's frenzied roar. Instead, he heard his master's voice, his companions' voices, his own voice— "What makes a blade?" He had once forged shackles to cage the mighty foes. Now, he would forge himself into a prison. As a hunter, his sole pursuit had been the elusive release of death. Now, he would take revenge on the architect of this tragedy. He felt himself cracking apart. Piece by piece. Shard by shard. Like snowflakes torn asunder, frozen in an instant by a surge of boundless life, then sent drifting once more into the sea of suffering. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft. Good." With great effort, he raised his hand, just as he had many years ago when he first lifted the forging hammer, striking the white-hot metal until it was sharp enough to plunge that immortal abomination to unending hell. His scorching iron body couldn't shed tears. In his daze, he could almost believe he was still in the Forge, blazing with blinding radiance like a divine weapon fresh from quenching.
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: He thought of that lonely island of Insumousu, bristling with rusted, broken swords. He wanted to go back, just once, to let those sword cries of grief, of hatred, of sorrow, rest in peace, if only for a moment. He thought of his aging master, and the warmth born of longing and shame welled up in his chest. Closing his eyes, he could almost smell the smoke and fire of the Zhuming, hear the endless rhythm of hammers on anvils. "Once this is all over, maybe I could..." He let out a long sigh. Then he turned and walked back to the Hunters' camp. "Mara-struck? He's completely cured... At least he's no longer clamoring to skin that little azure dragon alive." "Oh, right, about that box Blade mentioned, he admitted that the stuff inside was a gift for us!" He gently pushed the door open, frowning: "Do I really need to report matters unrelated to the mission to her as well?" "Bladie, thank you." A woman's voice came through the phone. "No need." "We'll celebrate for you once everyone is back." The man paused, took a few steps, then stopped again. "The item in the iron box is poorly made. If you want, I can make another." "Okay, sure," the young girl looked at him in surprise, "then why don't you tell her yourself? Look, talking to you just made me have to restart again!" He didn't reply, but turned around and headed to the next room. "Practice hard, the next time we PK when your hand is healed, I won't go easy on you." "Okay." He unfastened the Shard Sword and placed it by the bed. In the past, it was resentment, it was fury, it was regret, it was the embodiment of all agony. He stroked the shattered blade. What exactly constitutes a blade? Perhaps a blade is simply a blade, nothing more.
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: I remember you, {NICKNAME}. Time has made us both sharper. Yet you are still you... and I am still me.

voice.text: You're here. ...Have you eaten?
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: Though our paths have diverged... the bond between us remains unbroken.
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: A shattered body reforged, tempered through countless deaths. After a thousand trials, a new "Blade" is born.
voice.title: About Self: Mortenax

voice.text: It gave me an infinite lifespan of suffering, so I will return the favor with an inferno of endless torment. This undying body will be forged a thousand times over, tempered in fury until it turns pitch-black. I will make it understand... the true pain of living.
voice.title: About Self: Shuhu's Flesh

voice.text: For me, the hardest part of forging is choosing a name... Such as "Cloud-Piercer" and "Shard Sword"... They've kept me awake through many sleepless nights.
voice.title: Chat: Forging

voice.text: I have no interest in the role of "Supplicant." I'm not here to worship. I'm here to settle the past.
voice.title: Chat: Phantasmoon Games

voice.text: We play our parts in the "script," yet beyond it, we became companions.
voice.title: Chat: Stellaron Hunters

voice.text: The hot springs in Planarcadia are comfortable, but they dull your edge. Bone-chilling cold water on the other hand, that's what helps me relax.
voice.title: Hobbies: Cold Springs

voice.text: At the moment before death, memories come flooding back... and that hurts more than death itself.
voice.title: Annoyances

voice.text: The sword in my hand has shattered twice, true to its name, "Shard Sword." I still remember its first forging. It was nothing more than a failed, broken blade. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft." By that creed, it was reborn again and again through destruction.
voice.title: Share

voice.text: Once, the only thing that kept me alive was death. That part hasn't changed. The difference is... now I understand what I'm willing to die for.
voice.title: Knowledge

voice.text: I knew little of you before, until you set foot on another path, one called "Trailblaze."
voice.title: About {NICKNAME}

voice.text: My hand's healed quite a bit. I should be able to keep my promise and play with her this time. Still, I won't be nearly as skilled with a controller as I am with a sword.

voice.text: In a final blaze, we parted with the past. Yet where we go from here remains uncertain.

voice.text: She has done much to suppress the mara. Now that I've broken my shackles, it's time I help her fulfill her wish.

voice.text: The debts Imbibitor Lunae owes... he has repaid many of them. But the past cannot be so easily erased.

voice.text: She walks beside me in the fight against "immortality."
