voice.text: We once believed miracles would always happen. That's what led to disaster... I hope she's thought through the consequences.
voice.title: About Yao Guang

voice.text: When I was young, he tried to convince me to leave with him and become a ranger. But I chose to stay and forge swords. If I had gone with him... There are no "ifs" in life.
voice.title: About Ashveil

voice.text: Ever since I left the forge behind and became a hunter, I've felt unworthy to face my master. But when this is over, if I return with what I've forged... maybe I won't let him down.

voice.text: If the body is to be honed, it must face a thousand blows.

story.text:
Hailing from a world beyond our universe where magic and magecraft coexist, this young mage tirelessly hones her skills. She is the Sixth Head of the Tohsaka family, a prestigious lineage of Fuyuki City mages.
Currently studying under a renowned Clock Tower mentor with deep ties to the Holy Grail War, she finds herself hopping across dimensions and planes just to finish an internship project...
"Huh? Where even am I?? Why isn't there a single wisp of magical energy here???"
"The... Holy Grail? Oh, thank goodness, I'm saved! Sorry, don't mind if I borrow this!"
story.title: Character Details

story.text: The Holy Grail War was a brutal massacre where mages fought to fulfill the victor's deepest wish. Now a student at the Clock Tower, Tohsaka rarely brings up this dark chapter of her past. Her classmates, her little sister, her teachers at the regular school, and her former mentor in magecraft (who, by the way, turned out to be her father's murderer)... A totally random cast of characters who never should have crossed paths ended up weaving the messy web of that cruel struggle. It was such a convoluted nightmare to explain and so easy to misunderstand, it was honestly better to keep her mouth shut. Whether she was the "winner" of the Holy Grail War or once the Master to King Arthur, if word got out, she wouldn't just be dealing with petty jealousy. If these Clock Tower snobs treated her like some clueless bumpkin from the Far East, the headache simply wouldn't be worth it... ...Yeah, right. Tohsaka couldn't care less about stuff like that. "I've got bigger fish to fry. Better keep my head down and play the perfect student," she'd tell herself. But of course, her mentor saw right through her little schemes. Thankfully, he was an eccentric softie... and her senior when it came to the Holy Grail War... "Ugh, seriously... How many coincidences can one world have?" Banter aside, the two clicked instantly. They completely disassembled the Holy Grail in Fuyuki City, finally putting an end to the centuries of torture this twisted magecraft rite had inflicted on the locals. Naturally, to the ordinary folks living blissfully unaware of the magecraft world, it just meant the rate of "gas explosions" and "traffic pile-ups" dipped by a few measly percentage points... But for Tohsaka? It meant her childhood had truly come to an end. "I'm leaving. You know what you have to do, right?" Today, she can finally face her father's parting instructions — hardly a proper dying wish — with an open heart. It might not be the exact glory her father had originally envisioned, but as long as she carries the Tohsaka name, walking away with a clear conscience is the best possible outcome.
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: The Holy Grail of her hometown has been disassembled, but the work of a mage must continue. Passed down through generations, the Tohsaka family's magecraft is rooted in Conversion. At its core, Conversion is the manipulation of power — its accumulation, flow, and alteration — using gems as the primary medium. "Yeah, I know it's a massive money pit, but I don't exactly have a choice. You can't replace the energy density of a gemstone. If you want groundbreaking results, you can't go penny-pinching on experimental materials..." "Ugh, okay, saying it doesn't hurt is a total lie... Of course it hurts! It hurts so much! Who the heck wants to pull in tens of millions a year only to end up living paycheck to paycheck!?" "...Sorry, where are my manners? At the end of the day, I have my reasons. I just have to do it." — "Conduct yourself with confidence and elegance." Such is the Tohsaka family motto. Though, if Ishtar caught wind of that, she'd probably just suggest Tohsaka become a pirate instead. Intimidation, robbery, fraud, these are perfectly standard ways to make a buck for the goddess of Venus. Threatening to demolish the netherworld, hijacking the house of heaven, getting the God of Wisdom blackout drunk to swindle a sacred vessel, letting Uruk citizens extort foreigners... Honestly, her rap sheet is quite the resume. Considering herself a bit of a bleeding heart, {RUBY_B#twintailed red devil}Tohsaka{RUBY_E#} has absolutely no idea how she ended up bound to a Goddess like that. "It couldn't possibly be just because I'm desperate for cash and she happens to be insanely greedy... right?" ...While the truth of the matter is far from that, it's admittedly pretty hard to completely rule out the possibility.
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: Ever since forging a bond with the goddess, Tohsaka's journeys across planes and dimensions have taken a rather bizarre turn. "How should I put this... It just feels like I keep ending up in weird places and running into weird situations. "For instance, one time I accidentally stumbled into a military fortress belonging to some random interstellar empire... Just as I was scrambling to find a place to hide, I realized they couldn't see me at all! I could wander wherever I wanted, like a ghost. "Another time, I visited a museum built on an asteroid, only to find it was full of fakes! The curator claimed that someone who looked exactly like me had stolen all the genuine artifacts four thousand years ago! "Oh, and get this! There was this seemingly normal city where the law strictly forbade anyone from saying 'I guarantee' in public. Anyone who broke the rule would be forced to transcribe their philosophical treatise On the Unreliability of Promises by hand. "I casually asked around about the book's origins. The locals told me it all started three thousand years ago as a note left behind by a passing goddess, which got continuously expanded by generations of philosophers until it became a full-blown treatise! "And the very first page of that book only has one sentence: 'I guarantee'..." ...BUT! Although it is quite unbelievable, to be fair, Ishtar is still a benevolent goddess. At the very least, in the myths, she never directly robbed mortals of their belongings— *Some smudged handwriting* Whenever civilization needed a guardian, she would always step up to fight the enemy of civilization, even if she was full of insincere complaints and stubborn price-gouging. Even rarer, when she realized she was actually aiding a tyrant, she could decisively abandon old pacts, retract her protection over the Assyrians, and help the Babylonians achieve their epic revenge. *Author's Note: During the writing process, I was in no way hinted to, bribed, or violently coerced by the noble Mistress of Heaven, Ishtar, or anyone affiliated with her.* "Some pretentious teacher at the Clock Tower claimed that THIS was the real reason I was able to form a bond with the goddess of Venus... "Honestly, what kind of person does he take me for?" Alright, let's just humor the idea that Tohsaka has never exhibited "insincere complaints" or "stubborn price-gouging," nor does she have any experience of originally intending to win the Holy Grail, only to resolutely destroy it in the end. However, even so, there still seems to be some connection between Tohsaka and Ishtar that leaves us in wonder...
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: "...Huh? Are you trying to say we're both 'spoiled rich kids'? "No. Thank. You. Phrasing it like that makes it sound like I was born just to leech off others... Though, if someone hated me for my background, I guess it'd make sense. "Even if the one person who had every right to hate me didn't mind at all... "...But I digress. Call me a 'spoiled rich kid' if you must. "With great power comes great responsibility. Like I've always said: As the Tohsaka family head, I have things I simply must do." "As for the goddess of Venus... Hmph, she definitely doesn't see things from that angle!" "As the darling among the gods, she's probably never felt a drop of stress in her life. I mean, she's totally unapologetic about everything she does, be it blowing up mountains, descending into the underworld, proposing on a whim, or flipping out at the drop of a hat— "Ugh, speaking of which, it's honestly no surprise she'd try to woo that arrogant Goldy!" "But, if you really think about it... she must have her own principles, right? She can't be totally unhinged... probably. "The Assyrians worshiped her just as devoutly as the Urukians did. If her whole vibe was just 'I help whoever pays the best,' she would've completely ignored those broke Babylonians when they came begging. "Yet she actually answered their prayers and helped them ensnare the Assyrian capital... "...Wait, why am I defending her? You saw it too! No matter who she helps, that goddess's ultimate goal is still just to rule the world and boss everyone around! "As for why she meddles in things she could easily walk away from... at the end of the day, she's just being capricious, right? "For her, it's always 'I'm doing this because it's fun,' not 'I'm doing this because it's right'... which makes her the exact opposite of someone with my strong sense of justice!"
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: The contract is complete. Relax, I'm not really one for strict hierarchies... well, not for most people, anyway. Got that, my Servant?
voice.title: First Meeting

voice.text: Good morning. As the head of the Tohsaka family, maintaining proper etiquette is simply a matter of course.
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: Until tomorrow, then. Even if we're both "blessed" by our respective gods, we still have to forge our own paths, don't we?
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: The Tohsakas were co-founders of the Holy Grail War. We're local nobility, really, though our history is brief. It's just... thanks to my "poor management," we're not quite as "noble" as we used to be.
voice.title: About Self: Tohsaka Family

voice.text: The Holy Grail War began as a masterpiece, created by three great magicians pursuing their own noble ideals. Sadly, things didn't quite go as planned... Still, I'll keep moving forward on the path they paved. I am the head of the Tohsakas, after all.
voice.title: Chat: Holy Grail War

voice.text: See these jewels? They're the signature of the Tohsaka family. As long as I imbue them with magical energy beforehand, I can unleash all sorts of magecraft on a whim... only to watch those priceless gems serving as the vessel shatter right before my eyes... Ha... hahahaha...
voice.title: Chat: Gem Magecraft

voice.text: Oh, it's a piece of cake. Powering on, shutting down, answering calls... even voice input. I mastered it all in no time. And get this: I can even clear games now, provided they don't require using the mouse and keyboard at the same time! Pretty impressive, right?
voice.title: Chat: Modern Technology

voice.text: Cats! Definitely cats! They are absolutely the cutest things in the — Wait, my regular hobbies? Uh... does strength training count?
voice.title: Hobbies

voice.text: One senseless waste after another, followed by a never-ending string of accidents... I wonder, is there truly some generational curse on the Tohsaka lineage?
voice.title: Annoyances

voice.text: If you don't live for yourself, you'll never understand the true meaning of happiness. So, no matter what the future holds, follow your heart and forge ahead with everything you've got!
voice.title: Something to Share

voice.text: If I had been born in this galaxy, I'd definitely want to be glanced at by "the Beauty" herself... Wait, she's been missing for ages? Oh...
voice.title: Knowledge

voice.text: Back in the Holy Grail War I lived through, we were once bound as Master and Servant... It's always reassuring to have the King of Knights' legendary blade at your side.
voice.title: About Saber

voice.text: Lancer might come across as a bit flippant, but he's actually a reliable big brother figure — a calm, tenacious warrior. Believe it or not, I actually owe him my life.
voice.title: About Lancer

voice.text: That guy... Even here, he's still got that infuriating expression that says "I'll handle everything, leave it to me." And on top of that, he acts like he's my guardian. I swear, I'll find a way to put him in his place one of these days!
voice.title: About Archer

voice.text: Whether in the history books or that Holy Grail War, that Goldy is in a league of his own when it comes to being a troublemaker. If he ever finds out I've accepted Ishtar's blessing... I'm dead meat.
voice.title: About Gilgamesh

voice.text: She loves watching humans get into trouble, yet she can't bring herself to just look away... That's why she granted me her blessing, isn't it? Honestly, she's a benevolent goddess at heart, after all~
voice.title: About Ishtar

voice.text: To shoulder the collective desires of all humanity... such a burden would eventually burn anyone to ash. Thank you, {NICKNAME}, for staying by his side until the very end.
voice.title: About Phainon

voice.text: Those two sisters are so similar to Sakura and me, yet entirely different, almost like two mirrors reflecting one another... I'm grateful to them. They helped me find our most precious treasure.
voice.title: About Castorice and Polyxia

voice.text: I never expected to be played by that detective... When it comes to scheming and disregarding everyone else's feelings, he's the spitting image of that King of Heroes.
voice.title: About Ashveil

voice.text: I had a hunch Ms. Kuchiba was hiding some massive secret... but even after the Holy Grail War ended, we're still completely in the dark! Well, it makes sense. A key character from the main series can't go spilling all their secrets in a spin-off, can they?
voice.title: About Kuchiba

voice.text: Madam Herta... A genius who commands the galaxy's attention, a trailblazer forging ahead on the Path of "Erudition"... My god, she's basically the ideal version of myself!
voice.title: About Herta

voice.text: A scholar with real combat discipline is a rare breed indeed, let alone one who's honed both to such perfection. If I have the chance, I'll definitely have to pick his brain on both fronts!
voice.title: About Dr. Ratio

voice.text: I promise: I shall shine brighter than the {RUBY_B#Venus}morning star{RUBY_E#}.

skills.name: Enkidu

story.text:
The King of Heroes from the dawn of human history, hailing from a world beyond the stars.
Being two-thirds divine and one-third mortal, he claims a natural-born prerogative to rule over all of creation.
Today, as ever, his boisterous laughter echoed through the heavens... until a certain goddess and eternal rival dragged him into a foreign realm.
Now, he sets forth once more to reclaim all that belongs to a king.
story.title: Character Details

story.text: "He beheld the ocean's deepest abysses and the very foundations of the Earth; he knew where all secrets lay, and all things were revealed to him." The epic records the king's final chapter: he attained absolute wisdom, witnessed every treasure, and unveiled the mysteries of the gods. He returned from a thousand-mile journey utterly spent, yet blessed with a peace transcending all earthly things, and set down the story of his life. "Hmph, what a shallow, pitiful fool you are. "Are you seriously suggesting that I was somehow mightier in that withering, aged form than the perfected one standing before you?" No, no, no! Of course not! Perhaps that introduction was a touch one-sided. Allow me to try a different angle. Gilgamesh, history's most ancient King of Heroes. Unlike the countless heroes throughout the ages driven by lofty ideals, his power springs from an appetite that can never be sated. From the ocean where the sun rises to the snow-capped peaks where it sets, every facet of human civilization was shaped under his guidance: boundless cities, boundless orchards, boundless mines... With superhuman vigor, he commanded everything his eyes could survey. Yet the very king who made the whole world flourish also worked his subjects to the bone... "Watch your tongue. How dare you let such clumsy metaphors reach my ears. One wrong word, and you'll lose your head. "But this once, I'll show mercy and spare your life." Huh? "At least you faithfully documented my great deeds... Hmph, though in truth, you've barely scratched the surface. "Indeed... Ultimate power, ultimate extravagance, ultimate authority, this is my way. "If such a ruler did not exist in this world, those mediocre fools who cower before tyranny yet lack the spine to strike down my head would have perished long ago, crushed beneath the gods' pathetic whims." As you can see, dear reader: Gilgamesh is the sort of stubborn character who takes "doing whatever he pleases" to its absolute extreme. Now, in that age when gods treated mortals like weeds and beasts roamed the land unchecked, the king's logic held some water... but everything has its limits. When even newlywed couples had to revolve around the king like spinning tops, the people's complaints rose to the heavens themselves. Pushed by the goddess Ishtar, the gods — already fearful of humanity's relentless progress — decided to forge an unbreakable "Enkidu" to rein in the arrogant King. And so, filled with joy, Enkidu descended to the mortal realm.
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: "The Epic got it right: our first encounter was indeed before the altar of the sacred marriage ceremony." "Hmph... To think a mere clod of dirt would dare spew such nonsense, claiming they would 'correct my arrogance.'" "Utterly absurd." Despite these words, the king — for reasons unknown, though I boldly guess it was out of sheer surprise or even rage at meeting a worthy opponent for the very first time — finally took the fight seriously. Enkidu's form ebbed and flowed at will, shaping incalculable weapons that swept toward the king like a torrential storm. In the face of this desperate impasse, the king, in a rare moment of imitation, did the unthinkable: he flung wide the gates of his treasury, heartlessly casting forth his riches as a hail of stones. "If it's an opponent of equal standing, it wouldn't matter even if the coffers ended up completely empty." Reaching this point in the story, the king added this unprompted remark. His perpetually furrowed brow seemed to relax a fraction as he shifted his gaze to the sky outside the window. Soon, the tale resumed: Despite pulling out all the stops, the king simply couldn't suppress that "mere clod of dirt." The battle ended without a victor. "Back then, we had yet to understand what survival even meant." "To keep fighting would have only added two more foolish corpses to the pile." The clay tablets bearing the epic are hopelessly fragmented here, so no one knows why Enkidu agreed to make peace with Gilgamesh. Perhaps the old adage of "friendship forged in battle" is the best explanation we have. Regardless, Enkidu joined Uruk. For the very first time, this great city had someone who could stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the king. The king remained as willful as ever. Only this time, the people of Uruk could finally find genuine joy in his antics. Together with Enkidu, he slaughtered the demonic beast Huwawa in the cedarwood forest, and later struck down the Bull of Heaven, Gugalanna, sent by the goddess Ishtar in a fit of spite. The list of such heroic legends is endless... In this crisis-ridden world, they briefly became champions whose names thundered across the lands. "To truly practice what they call 'protection,' summoning a biting north wind is sometimes a necessary evil." The age when the gods could casually summon a flood to bring about an apocalypse is truly gone forever... But laying a lethal curse upon a legendary hero? That, they can still do without breaking a sweat.
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: Enkidu was dead. Everyone knew this was a curse from the Gods. Humans had long understood that defying the divine would carry a price; yet, when the toll was finally called, everyone seemed caught utterly off guard... Especially the king, who had once boasted that he "knew not the meaning of the fear of death." "Absurd. How could I possibly shed tears over the death of a friend?" "Come to think of it, I am the one who reigns over all creation; how could I possibly possess an existence known as a 'friend'?" "Even if I did have one, I've forgotten their name." ...An answer that avoided the question. At any rate, as the epic tells: Gilgamesh departed Uruk. He crossed mountains and rivers until he reached a tavern at the edge of the world. The master of the tavern was Siduri. She interrogated Gilgamesh on his origins until she was certain the traveler was worthy of her guidance. Only then did she reveal the secret of how to cross the world's end to reach the land of eternal life. There dwelt the most ancient of men, Utnapishtim, known in Sumerian as Ziusudra. A survivor of the Great Flood of antiquity, he had lived in isolation until the present era. "Ah, I remember him." "One who obtained immortality by being inscribed into the divine registers. And for that very same reason, lost his form of flesh and blood, becoming an existence more wretched than even the flora of the earth..." "...Utterly foolish. Had this been the only cost of immortality, I would never accept it." Left with no choice, the elder bestowed Gilgamesh another secret, so that he might obtain eternal life and youth without having to beg the gods for mercy. "Even if that old fellow lied to me, it would still be a rare treasure, worthy enough to adorn my treasury." "Thus, this king set out once more on a journey to find the 'herb of immortality'." And so it was, but unfortunately... "...There is nothing to be regretful about. I found the herb, sealed it in a bottle, and returned to Uruk. Exactly as the legend says, without a single lie." "Now then, let this interview end here. My time is precious, and I must now see to matters regarding my banned streaming channel." Unfortunately, O king, there is no escape. The true conclusion of the epic is as follows: While Gilgamesh was bathing and changing his clothes to return to Uruk, he watched helplessly as a common snake swallowed the herb... Yet in that moment, the king could not help but burst into laughter, laughing until his body and face were nearly distorted. By the time he came to his senses, the light of dawn had broken once more. Later, the king returned to Uruk, empty-handed. Future readers, please do not blame Gilgamesh, for the wanderer must always return home.
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: The epic concludes here. The contents of the final tablet are more akin to a brief encore performance following the fall of a grand opera's curtain. Times have changed. Millennia later, Gilgamesh became a Heroic Spirit because of this very epic. "Fool! It is not that I became a Heroic Spirit because of the epic. It is that the epic, through my telling of it, finally attained such value!" "Before me, the world was ruled by gods. After me, the world was returned to humanity. It is true that Uruk has long since fallen to ruin, but no city can escape such a fate, not even {RUBY_B#The Great God's Aquatic Capital}the Abzu of Enlil{RUBY_E#}." "Yet humans are unlike gods. They build new cities, allowing new life to endure in new lands. Therefore..." "Every city of man is my Uruk, and all are worthy of my dominion and my lash!" ...What on earth is this man rambling on about? And yet, unexpectedly, though his words are full of grievances, no trace of anger can be heard in the king's laughter. "Enough. Return to the battlefield, security officer. We have much to do." "The scarcity of food, the ravages of disease, the monotony of pleasure... You have gradually overcome these human deficiencies, yet the 'ego' continues to wither amidst sickly indulgences..." "This land is already diseased to the core. But as long as I stand here, this city shall not fall." Good grief, the King of Heroes is still the same as ever. Fearless since the Age of Gods, forever holding his own standards as the absolute law. "Of course, before that... you must reclaim every last one of my scattered treasures." "Otherwise, by the time I personally raze this land in place of those foul things lurking in the abyss, it will be too late for regrets." ...There he goes again with the classic villain speech. Still, I have already found the answer I was looking for. Now, together with everyone else, let us head to the battlefield once more.
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: Stellaron, my treasure. When you reach the end of your journey, I shall seal you within the deepest depths of my treasury, in the safest place of all... Hmph. That said, your Trailblaze shall endure for a long time yet, reaching even beyond the ultimate horizon of my own foresight.
voice.title: First Meeting

voice.text: Since you're a treasure and not a subject, there's no need to grovel at my feet.
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: There are plenty of other treasures waiting around for my affection. You're dismissed.
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: My class? Boring. How could a class shorter than my own exalted name possibly encompass my multifaceted majesty?! Let that faker take pride in claiming such a trivial title.
voice.title: About Self: Class

voice.text: Life is nothing but "dying now" or "dying later." In other words, once I deem that something "should vanish at once," be it warrior, god, or treasure, I'll show no mercy.
voice.title: Chat: Way of the King

voice.text: I have gathered every treasure in existence and built a vault known as the "Gate of Babylon." Its contents are so vast that I sealed many chambers away without even glancing at them... Hm? I have no intention of leaving you in a place like that. At the very least, it has to be the ultimate inner sanctum guarded by seven layers of seals!
voice.title: Chat: Treasury

voice.text: You expect me to call you a "friend"? Hah! I like that gumption that fears not even a god! Yet, abandon such thoughts. The only existence I could call my dear friend is already a part of my past. Now, speak of this no more.
voice.title: Chat: Friendship

voice.text: Indulge in your desires, challenge all, conquer all, plunder all, crush any existence that dares obstruct my pursuit of Elation. If one does not live thus as a human, what difference is there from those mongrel beasts who only know how to grovel and beg?
voice.title: Hobbies

voice.text: The "Golden Rule" may appear a blessing, yet it is a curse in truth. Upon manifesting in this era, I initiated a livestream to secure funds for my endeavors. Within mere moments, I had earned a fortune and was promptly banned. I did naught but grace them with a glimpse of my august form, yet they lost their wits with infatuation. Mongrels, the lot of them.
voice.title: Annoyances

voice.text: I do not merely plunder. I also bestow all that you have earned. Be proud. That I recognize such merit in you is proof enough that you are a treasure beyond compare.
voice.title: Something to Share

voice.text: Humans are fools, yet the things they create possess true value. This universe of yours is the ultimate proof of my judgment.
voice.title: Knowledge

voice.text: To a King, a nation is nothing more than a possession. If you cannot dominate it, you might as well cast aside the crown. That is why she was consumed by her own nation.
voice.title: About Saber

voice.text: He's got brawn and brains in spades. But for all his skill with that lance, he's not quite ready to be called a king.
voice.title: About Lancer

voice.text: A "champion of justice"? A world where no one gets hurt? He says such ridiculous things. The pretense of equality is nothing more than drivel by the weak who cannot face darkness. His ideal is just an excuse to cover up ugliness.
voice.title: About Archer

voice.text: Once you've chosen the path of the arcane, you can only march toward something beyond human — but perhaps that girl, an Average One, can truly Trailblaze a path never seen before.
voice.title: About Rin Tohsaka

voice.text: Donning that girl's face seems to have made that useless goddess look a good deal brighter. Although I shall never forgive the transgressions of her past... Hmph. It is a fortunate turn of events that she has learned a modicum of discipline within the confines of a mortal vessel.
voice.title: About Ishtar

voice.text: A true hero is one who shoulders all they behold, without exception. I had thought myself the only existence capable of enduring the collective weight of this world, to think this cosmos held another capable of such a feat. However, a flaw remains. He is far too humble! If one possesses the strength to bear the world, he need not call himself a Deliverer. He must claim the title of king!
voice.title: About Phainon

voice.text: So, the participant paired against me is that "broken-legged wolf"? Hardly a surprise. If you are looking for someone whose losses could rival my own, you will find no other in this Holy Grail War.
voice.title: About Ashveil

voice.text: In that vast universe, those who share my refined tastes are few and far between. For the most part, humans are nothing more than beasts devoid of self-awareness. Since you have found your resolve, the next step is slaying gods. I look forward to that day with great anticipation.
voice.title: About Herta and Dr. Ratio

voice.text: That security officer is far from the simple-looking girl she appears to be. Quiet as she may seem, once she is moved to action, she becomes a merciless, unrestrained beast of pure performance... Hmph. Why must I always be surrounded by such eccentricities?
voice.title: About Kuchiba

voice.text: The king acknowledges it. The king permits it. The king shoulders the entire world.
voice.title: Eidolon Activation

voice.text: To gaze upon the majesty of my origins? Such audacious impudence!
voice.title: Character Ascension

voice.text: Hmph. It seems I must show you my true might. Be grateful for such a spectacle, won't you?
voice.title: Max Level Reached

voice.text: This pittance isn't worth a glance! See the Echo of War over there? Do not keep your King waiting!
voice.title: Trace Activation

voice.text: My treasure must be the finest of the fine. See that you do not disappoint me!
voice.title: Added to Team With {NICKNAME}

voice.text: King of Knights, I permit you to challenge my might.
voice.title: Added to Team With Saber

voice.text: Faker. See how a true original outshines an impostor.
voice.title: Added to Team With Archer

voice.text: Not Ishtar, but you yourself? Good. You just cheated fate.
voice.title: Added to Team With Rin Tohsaka

voice.text: Struggle and crawl for your life as best you can, mongrel.

voice.text: Tch.

voice.text: Why you! You! YOU!

voice.text: Awaken, Ea!

voice.text: Gaze upon the primordial truth — Enuma Elish!
voice.title: Ultimate: Unleash

voice.text: Hahahahahahahaha!
voice.title: Joint Follow-Up ATK 1

voice.text: What a magnificent view!
voice.title: Joint Follow-Up ATK 2

voice.text: I'll retreat this time...!
voice.title: Downed

voice.text: Rejoice, for your king has returned!
voice.title: Return to Battle

voice.text: Heh... Truly, a sight as refreshing as an oasis in the desert.
voice.title: Health Recovery

voice.text: I shall restrain them!
voice.title: Technique

voice.text: To rule over all creation, there is none more suited for it than me!
voice.title: Battle Won

voice.text: A bargain-bin scrap. I shall deign to add it to my coffers regardless.
voice.title: Treasure Opening 1

voice.text: Rubbish. I shall deign to add it to my coffers regardless.
voice.title: Treasure Opening 2

voice.text: A modicum of worth. I shall deign to add it to my treasury regardless.
voice.title: Precious Treasure Opening

voice.text: Should this lock not have undone itself the moment I cast my gaze upon it? How utterly insolent.
voice.title: Successful Puzzle-Solving 1

voice.text: To think you would force me to lower my own hands to the task... You are hereby banished to the depths of the shadows!
voice.title: Successful Puzzle-Solving 2

voice.text: Mongrel, you are an eyesore. Go, strike him down.
voice.title: Enemy Target Found

voice.text: Raucous, empty noise... This place possesses none of Uruk's vitality.
voice.title: Returning to Town

story.text: Some fight side by side, some keep watch. The Trailblaze is never a lonely voyage.\nShe paints a trailblazing miracle. The silver rail stretches on, and the Nameless set sail once more, illuminating the galaxy's eternal night.\nAt the end of the line, she looks back once again. The dream of setting forth has never run aground.
story.title: Character Details

story.text: The girl's world had shrunk to just herself. The hospital's stark white sheets and curtains were like cold, impassive walls, sealing her off from the warm faces she kept in her memories. "Don't worry, Himeko. You're smart. You'll catch up even if you miss a few days!" "Himeko, you have to get better soon. We're still doing the model contest together!" "Himeko... we graduated without you..." ... Only the cold, mechanical beeping of monitors filled the room. She let her thoughts drift back to the stranded Express she had discovered, and kept sketching out those visions of setting sail. "Cosmic Station, now arriving at Cosmic Station!" A uniformed attendant rang the bell as a howling wind swept in from the distance. Though it was a little cold, she was still waving at the Express with barely contained exhilaration. "Himeko! Himeko, get on board!" A red-haired girl leaned out from the window, and a moment later, a firm hand pulled her up. In the blink of an eye, she found herself sinking into the Express's plush red velvet seat, face to face with a girl who seemed a little older, light flickering in her eyes. "Himeko, wanna take the wheel and head somewhere far away?" The familiar stranger asked with a smile. Yes! The word nearly tumbled right out of her. She wanted to talk, to have friends, to find companions, to put into words the ache in her body and the hollow longing in her heart. She wanted to run, to escape, to scream... "Come with me. Let's leave this place together." She hadn't said a word, yet somehow, the girl across from her seemed to have heard every last one of them. The girl felt a hand take hers, and her body seemed to dissolve into a night breeze, light as a feather, as though she were flying, guided by that gentle touch. Together, they brushed the wings of Cygnus and drifted through the heart of the Rosette Nebula. Icy comets streaked past the moon like a cascade of glittering gemstones. When the storm rolled in, the girl held her hand tight, weaving through the shattered debris of planetary rings, and when the skies grew calm again, the two of them watched the meteors of Sagittarius streak across the peaceful harbor... "She's so brave... just like the Navigators I've read about..." Wishes are like paint, each longing a stroke to shape the ideal into being.
story.title: Character Story: Part I

story.text: She breaks into a violent coughing fit, struggling to keep her brush steady. The time she has left before she can no longer move freely is limited, and in order to get the Express to start running again, she can only allocate this remaining time to the last second. "I'm so jealous of Motoko. No need for treatments or sleep... That must free up so much time!" The girl known as Motoko gently patted her on the head. "Well that's exactly why you imagenated me, silly... I'll help you make your dream of reaching the stars come true." She burned through her own time. First was the Express, newly-restored. Its once-rusted, corroded hull had transformed into a comfortable home. With the Starblazer's blueprint recovered, crafting a prototype was now within reach. But the engine still lacked the fuel needed for Trailblazing, and the countdown timer for her life was already ticking down. They turned their eyes to Phantasmoon Games. Even if the Weathering Curse could never be healed, perhaps, in that ceremony under the gaze of the gods, the Astral Express could carry them away into the cosmos. But the bloodstained tragedy played out cycle after cycle. The Supplicant known as the Herald of Death massacred his way through Dovebrook, turning arcadia into a crimson purgatory. One by one, the innocent fell to the devil's hands, their howls and screams carried away by the wind. She slumped against the rubble as her life bled silently from her wounds. Her vision went blurry, and through the smoke and ash, she searched for that familiar silhouette. Motoko stood there, fire reflected in her eyes. And her reflection, too, was within those eyes. "Do you remember the Trailblaze pledge we read?" Barely clinging to life, she reached out toward Motoko. "Even if we don't gain the upper hand, we'll fight for right. Even when there are wheels within wheels, go ahead. Get it pulverized..." "Isn't that a little childish... I'm not even one of the Nameless yet..." She looked at Motoko the way one looks at a Navigator who lights up the long night. "Himeko, you don't have to journey far to be one of the Nameless. And similarly, Trailblazing doesn't only begin with setting sail..." Under the hopeful gazes of those around, the Wishpower of Trailblazing drew the final stroke upon the "Starblazer." The giant of Pegana descended from the sky, smashing the frenzied killer into pieces. Beneath the glow of the Phantasmoon, the Express soared into deep space. But this time, only a single soul made the departure.
story.title: Character Story: Part II

story.text: The teenage girl's Trailblazing was fraught with thorns. With the silver rail blocked, she had no choice but to feel her way through the universe, remapping the astral charts. She had once been lost in desolate frontier worlds, venturing in and out of dangerous ruins just to scrape together dwindling supplies. And now, once again, she was to press on alone. She was targeted by space pirates, and in those moments of imminent peril, she did everything to shake off those desperadoes, those relics of the Energy War. She once faced a Swarm that darkened the sky. The silver rails that she painstakingly repaired over months were destroyed in an instant. She reached out to help a world on the brink of being devoured by a black hole, only to be mistaken for a malevolent visitor from beyond, and nearly lost her life at the edge of the black hole. ... "Am I really the one meant to walk this path?" At the tail end of her dreams of the Phantasmoon Games, she would often see another version of herself at the helm of the Express, soaring off into the deep reaches of space. Yet, whenever they reunited in those dreams, that graceful and poised Navigator would always look back at her with eyes full of encouragement— "Is the Rosette Nebula of the Celestial Comet System as beautiful as we always dreamed it would be? "Are the silver rails you repaired forging bonds between worlds long cut off from one another? "I know that your fearless Trailblazing saved an entire people from their destiny..." "But I... don't know how much longer I can hold on..." She sighs wearily. "Don't you remember? 'Nameless' was never just one person's name. Just as the flame of the Trailblaze set you ablaze, so will it set others ablaze too." Outside the window, the wings of Cygnus shimmered, and icy comets streaked past the moon like a cascade of glittering gemstones. She steered the Express through the shattered debris of planetary rings, and when she finally reached the peaceful harbor, the meteors of Sagittarius happened to cascade down. Welt and his golden-haired companion stepped aboard the Express. When the Express fell into peril, the taciturn Dan Heng took down the beast with a single strike. In that moment, she saw the fire inside him, and offered him the navigator's invitation. She rescued March 7th, adrift in the cosmos, and from that day on, the trailblazing expedition took on the hue of March's vibrant color. Guided by destiny, she crossed paths with {NICKNAME} at the space station. Somehow, the feeling that this brave, free-spirited child would bring endless surprises in the future never left her. Jarilo-VI, the Xianzhou Luofu, Penacony, Amphoreus... More and more people walk alongside the "Trailblaze," and she has found companions truly worthy of being called "family," and her name has been engraved across countless worlds. By all accounts, this was a miracle, and one that she hoped wholeheartedly would never end.
story.title: Character Story: Part III

story.text: She returned to the point of departure. She knew the shadow of Destruction had never truly left, just as the bliss in Planarcadia was only a result of postponed calamity. She witnessed the return of the Herald of Death, her homeland lacerated in the maw of the beast. She uncovered the root of the curse, trembling as she accepted the truth of her family's tragedy. But this was an entirely unprecedented apocalypse. It made her face the possibility of losing her companions, {NICKNAME} most of all. She couldn't understand why the fate of the cosmos had to rest on {M#his}{F#her} shoulders. All she knew was that {M#he}{F#she} was now family, forever. So, once again, she chose to carry it all alone, just as she always used to say: "Traveling always has an end point. When it happens, I'll smile and say goodbye to everyone." Amidst the mockery of the world falling into utter silence, the Starblazer reached its limit, and the Express crashed once more. Before the farewell, she embraced {NICKNAME} and made a wish to the Stellaron to guard the Trailblaze. The stars grew hazy in a crimson mist, and she became as weak as she once was. "It's been so long. You've grown up... and become even more remarkable than I ever was." For a fleeting moment, she thought she could feel the girl's warmth again as if she were still there, watching over her in silence. "I think I've finally gotten a little closer to you." She couldn't help but pour out everything that had happened since they parted: The paths walked by the legendary Navigators, now trodden by her own feet; the wonders she had once only dreamed of, witnessed with her own eyes; the companions she had found, those kindred spirits, people she could truly trust... "Just as you once traded your destiny for mine, I would trade my destiny for my companions'..." "But look, your companions aren't about to let you go anywhere." {NICKNAME}'s wish moved her to tears. The unyielding defiance of the Nameless set her blood ablaze once more. "Where your journey ends, mine begins anew..." Two warm hands withdrew gently from her back, and the girl smiled with quiet tenderness, their silhouette slowly merging with each other. "If there's nothing ahead of us..." She became one with the ideal she had always strived toward, as her companions reached out their hands and cried out together, "Then we'll Trailblaze a path forward with our own hands!"
story.title: Character Story: Part IV

voice.text: {NICKNAME}, no matter how tangled our pasts or how distant the future, our bond remains unchanged. I am Himeko, Navigator of the Astral Express... and your family, always looking out at the same horizon as you.
voice.title: First Meeting

voice.text: Care for a cup of my new blend? Trust me, this one definitely won't be a disaster.
voice.title: Greeting

voice.text: Don't worry. While I'm away, I'm leaving the Express in your capable hands.
voice.title: Parting

voice.text: Fifteen years ago, we repaired this fallen train and began our journey. Since then, it's your dreams and aspirations that have given it such vibrant new colors. Every time I witness your trailblazing spirit, I'm reminded of why I started this journey in the first place. The destination doesn't matter. What matters is that we're on this path together.
voice.title: About Self: Nova

voice.text: For as long as I can remember, my family's inherited illness was my deepest fear. Even though I've moved past it, our lives are still just a blink in the eyes of the universe. But without that fear of how fleeting life is, would we ever find the drive to reach for the furthest stars?
voice.title: About Self: Weathering Curse

voice.text: Before I became the "reliable adult" you all see today, "absurdity" was just my everyday life. Back in Planarcadia, if someone started flying or cheated death, it was usually just part of the "Game"... When you look at it that way, my dream of chasing the stars doesn't seem like such a big deal, does it?
voice.title: Chat: Childhood

voice.text: To suit everyone's palate, I've whipped up beetroot black coffee for March, a mung bean soda latte for Dan Heng, and even a giant terror bird egg hand-made coffee for Sunday... You just want a regular cup? Come on, where's the "Trailblaze" in that?
voice.title: Chat: Coffee

voice.text: Maybe I've spent too much time on blueprints. I'm always trying to capture every detail with precise lines. It can get a bit... rigid sometimes. There's so many styles out there. I'd love to try some improvised ink splatters or even dive into abstract art when I have the time.
voice.title: Chat: Painting

voice.text: Back in my student days, I was quite the connoisseur of old-school martial arts films. I've still got all those combat techniques memorized by heart. Maybe I'll show off a few moves next time, just to make sure I'm not getting rusty.
voice.title: Hobbies: Martial Arts Films

voice.text: It's been a while since I've handled the heavy lifting myself... Besides my molecular saw and satellites, I think it's time to pack some serious firepower in this briefcase.
voice.title: Annoyances

voice.text: I have been away from Planarcadia for so long that coming back gave me a bit of a culture shock... The holographic ads are too loud, the street gangs are a nuisance, and the management of imagenae is a mess... But after seeing so many disasters, this chaotic energy feels much more like home than a deathly silence ever could.
voice.title: Something to Share

voice.text: The blueprints for the "Starblazer" are kept right in the Express archives. It's a "Legacy of Trailblaze" in every sense of the word. Back on Pegana, the ancients used it to extend their fragile reach, sprinting across the galaxy to pluck the very stars from the sky. I wonder what the romance of your generation will look like.
voice.title: Knowledge

voice.text: Truth be told, from the moment I first saw you, I picked up on this sharp, slightly playful sense of humor... Maybe that's just my Planarcadia intuition talking.
voice.title: About {NICKNAME}

voice.text: I used to worry that as the weight of our journey grew, I'd eventually stop seeing March's signature smile. Looking at her now, she's certainly matured, but that spark of innocence that makes her who she is? That's never faded for a second.
voice.title: About March 7th

voice.text: Enjoying the Trailblaze is just as important as the destination, and I'm glad he's finally starting to get that. I suspect Dan Heng will only get better at his "Xianzhou's Number One Assassin" routine from here on out.
voice.title: About Dan Heng

voice.text: Welt's passion for the Starblazer still caught me by surprise... He's been working on his Starblazer comic every single day lately. Honestly, if I'd known he'd be this obsessed, I should've let him stay in the pilot's seat a little longer.
voice.title: About Welt

voice.text: Though wearing the Supplicant's mask came about by accident, those constant twists of fate have instead brought his potential to "Trailblaze" the unknown into full view.
voice.title: About Sunday

voice.text: If Pom-Pom knew I'd asked you to look after them, I can already hear the grumpy correction: "Who's looking after who here!?" But between us... I know Pom-Pom secretly loves every second of it.
voice.title: About Pom-Pom

voice.text: Most of my memories before the age of six are a blur now... just fragments of a dream. A rattling toy, moonlight catching a strand of crimson hair, a dab of paint someone snuck onto my nose... but the moment I open my eyes, they're gone.
voice.title: About Ryusuke

voice.text: What lies at the end of the Trailblaze? He showed us one of the darkest possible answers with his own life. No matter how far our journey takes us, please, keep the oath of the Nameless etched forever in your hearts.
voice.title: About Asat Pramad

voice.text: Once upon a time, we'd weave through the bustling crowds together, sit by the banks of the Dovebrook just watching the water flow, or hide away in our "secret base" trying to figure out how to fix those broken parts... Motoko never really left. In the quiet of a thousand lonely nights, I can still feel her gaze, steady and watching over me, as I fulfill the promise we made at the very start.
voice.title: About Motoko

voice.text: We crossed paths once, during the last season of the Phantasmoon Games. Carrying the weight of an entire world on her shoulders while looking that effortless... Honestly, I could learn a thing or two from that kind of grace under pressure.
voice.title: About Evanescia

voice.text: Maybe one day, she'll just appear out of nowhere and give us one of those graceful smiles. After all, finding a glimmer of hope in the middle of the impossible? That's always been her specialty.
voice.title: About Yao Guang

voice.text: Looking back, the show Sparxie put on was actually the kindest performance in the entire Phantasmoon Games. If all the Fools had her sense of restraint, maybe thrilling comedies would be the rule rather than the exception.
voice.title: About Sparxie

voice.text: As a navigator, I can relate to how difficult it is to lead a team forward. Instead of trying to shoulder everything alone, learning to lean on your companions... well, it makes the journey a lot easier to bear.
voice.title: About Ashveil

voice.text: In the Phantasmoon Games fifteen years ago, I briefly stood at the very peak of "Elation" myself. To keep a cool head in the face of that kind of temptation... her understanding of the "Game" has far exceeded my expectations.
voice.title: About Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: The starlight we've woven together... whose future will it illuminate next?
voice.title: Eidolon Activation

voice.text: Just as promised that day, I haven't stopped pressing on for a single moment.
voice.title: Character Ascension

voice.text: Here, I stand at before yet another new beginning.
voice.title: Max Level Reached

voice.text: This journey we share... It's as vivid and brilliant as the stars themselves.
voice.title: Trace Activation

voice.text: The stage is yours, {NICKNAME}.
voice.title: Added to Team With {NICKNAME}

voice.text: Carrying our past promise with us, let's set off once more.
voice.title: Added to Team With Himeko

voice.text: March, you'll have to keep us safe this time, alright?
voice.title: Added to Team With March 7th

voice.text: Take your time. We'll always be here to help you carry the load.
voice.title: Added to Team With Evernight

voice.text: Thanks for always having our backs, Dan Heng. The Express is lucky to have you.
voice.title: Added to Team With Dan Heng

voice.text: Do it your way, Dan Heng. I trust your judgment.
voice.title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae

voice.text: Mhm, I'll be on guard as well.
voice.title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae

voice.text: You always say growth is a privilege of the young. Well, your chance has finally arrived.
voice.title: Added to Team With Welt

voice.text: Do what you need to. Having you here puts everyone at ease.
voice.title: Added to Team With Sunday

voice.text: General Yao Guang, thank you. Your presence comes with the great fortune.
voice.title: Added to Team With Yao Guang

voice.text: From enemies to friends... Trailblazing really does work in mysterious ways.
voice.title: Added to Team With Sparxie

voice.text: Miss Evanescia, anything not explicitly against the rules is fair game, right?
voice.title: Added to Team With Evanescia

voice.text: It's a pleasure. It seems the Nameless and the Rangers share the same path after all.
voice.title: Added to Team With Ashveil

voice.text: Welcome aboard, Hunter. I'll leave the information war to you.
voice.title: Added to Team With Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>

voice.text: I'm not that easy to bring down.
voice.title: Battle Begins: Weakness Break

voice.text: Keep your guard up.
voice.title: Battle Begins: Danger Alert

voice.text: You're about to relearn who the Nameless truly are.
voice.title: Turn Begins 1

voice.text: This time, I'm not fighting alone.
voice.title: Turn Begins 2

voice.text: Tired? Let's get you another cup of coffee.
voice.title: Turn Idling

voice.text: Let's warm up.
voice.title: Basic ATK

voice.text: I'll safeguard your path ahead!
voice.title: Skill 1

voice.text: This journey leads us starward!
voice.title: Skill 2

voice.text: A minor setback.
voice.title: Hit by Light Attack

voice.text: Pretty tough...
voice.title: Hit by Heavy Attack

voice.text: Toward more distant horizons!
voice.title: Assist Skill 1

voice.text: The fire carries on. Together... we are the Trailblaze!
voice.title: Ultimate: Activate

voice.text: Starblazer: Star-blazing judgment, execute!\nHimeko • Nova: Become the stars, and light up the cosmic night!
voice.title: Ultimate: Unleash

voice.text: Starblazer, set forth.
voice.title: Talent

voice.text: In your hands now...
voice.title: Downed

voice.text: I'll always be here.
voice.title: Return to Battle

voice.text: Good thing you're here.
voice.title: Health Recovery

voice.text: Starblazer: Starblazer online. Initiating route clearance.
voice.title: Technique

voice.text: The Nameless has never been just one person's name.
voice.title: Battle Won

voice.text: You've got a good eye.
voice.title: Treasure Opening 1

voice.text: The best rewards come unannounced.
voice.title: Treasure Opening 2

voice.text: Feels like a good moment to share a Fortune Pouch in the crew chat.
voice.title: Precious Treasure Opening

voice.text: Give me a real challenge.
voice.title: Successful Puzzle-Solving 1

voice.text: Thinking outside the box is a skill in itself.
voice.title: Successful Puzzle-Solving 2

voice.text: How should we take it down? It's your call.
voice.title: Enemy Target Found

voice.text: It's been too long... I actually miss the Express's sofa.
voice.title: Returning to Town

voice.text: Drive toward new dawns!
voice.title: Assist Skill 2

story.text: A {F#girl}{M#boy}, {NICKNAME}, decides to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the threat of the Stellaron.
story.title: About "You"

story.text:
You don't remember much.
You're not from around here, nor did you come from elsewhere. You're not really going anywhere—
Just then, that indistinct voice whispers into your ear. That sorrowful and tender persuasion, that deceptive goading...
The seeds take root. You open your eyes, and the speaker is no longer there.

But there are more and more voices, and they are getting clearer and clearer.
Some give easygoing care, some calmly provide advice, some speak firm support, and some gift gentle direction...
You see the silken thread being woven to form tomorrow.

A huge beast descends from infinity,
golden pupils stare down from the darkness,
and you are no longer abandoned by the past.
You will also set upon a long journey,
and the thorns you have stepped on have become your path.

The train whistles, wishing you a successful journey to the coming future
...by your own will.
story.title: Your "Story": Part I

story.text:
You have arrived at the "City of Preservation."
Behind the snow curtain, the wind lashes like steel blades, but the kindling burns on.
Distant lands won't hear them, and the earth trembles in kind, with only the wailing crowds braving the wind.

After facing foreign enemies, the Eternal Freeze, and reality's fissures, a rot begins to fester within the fort.
You try lending a helping hand, but are forsaken.
Some once looked down on you and misunderstood you, but still you stood by their side and helped them find their way.
More care about you and worry about you. They face their suffering, and find the cure for the distressed.
Eventually, they come to your side.

In the ice and snow, you are like a fire, protecting the soul of this world
...Even though you must scorch yourself day and night.
story.title: Your "Story": Part II

story.text:
The harmonious music guides you to stumble into the sweet dream, as syrup and soda fill your throat.
The festival is grand, the crowd boisterous, and strangers cast on disguises to meet up in the dream.
You view to your hearts' desires the wondrous and otherworldly views, and part ways when dewdrops shimmer with the break of dawn —
When the pitch-black midnight has just begun.

The clock hands go tick-tock, and death follows closely like a shadow.
You are placed onto the table as a bargaining chip, but manage to win for yourself the right to uncover the secret.
You bring with you the dreams of the dead and continue on the road that they did not walk, facing the enemies they could not defeat—

The false god rises in the conglomeration of the multitude's wishes, and the unanimous song of the gazillions drowns out your existence.
Those walking on different roads take up each other's hands,
your melodies interweave with each other, faint but imperishable like the lights in a long night.
One after one, people startle awake from their dream. That tiny song finally merges into a deafening roar in the end, tearing free of the dream's curtains.

The eternal sweet dream scatters in a fleeting instant, and you finally understand why people slumber
— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.
story.title: Your "Story": Part III

required.missionName: Fallen Petals, Leave Fading Traces of Fragrance

story.text:
Look, in The Eternal Land, a nameless epic unfolds.
Listen. The wind's ballad sings the elegy of Era Nova, and witnesses the golden blood flowing through slumbering flowers, as the Coreflames sustain the scarred earth.
Like seeds about to perish, poems fade into obscurity.

For false endings shackle the story's beginning.
Count the cold fluorescent lights, sting the eyes that pray for dawn.
Time has yet to flow, the sun is set to die. Is this the story's climax, or the finale?
No, there's still... one final stroke.

And so you leave traces of "Trailblaze" on every page, where falls turn into ascents on another end.
You race through the mire of memories, using billions of Coreflames to scorch the frigid data sequences, and catching the shattered seed germs.
When a new blank page appears, you make your mark. It, too, will form ripples toward the past.

Glimmering lights twinkle in the night sky of blank memories, where a shooting star yet to come has been entrusted with the anticipation of eternity.
Thirteen heartbeats sing proudly for the Flame-Chase Journey, for that was the land they deeply cherished.
The first page of the story unfolds once more, inscribed with prophecies of life.

Listen! The wind sings a melody, the Seeds of Memory grow among the stars, for
the cosmos now knows the name, "Amphoreus."
story.title: Your "Story": Part IV

story.text:
You're a hero from beyond, an idol pursued by the masses. 
 Some want to put you on a pedestal, while others wait with bated breath for your fall. 
 The minute you step into this world, you become the center of attention.

You've been thrust into a game. 
 In a time when traffic means everything, spectacle after spectacle unfolds, each vying for more eyes. 
 In the end, heroes and clowns are viewed the same, and tragedies are not that different from comedies.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on? 
 The dice of destiny now rest in your palm. To wear the mask or cast it aside? The choice is always yours.

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain. 
 You raise your glow stick like a torch held high. 
 To stand at the center of the cosmos, one must possess the power to command the storm.

When met with malice, you still create wishes of kindness. 
 Without praise, you light your own way through the dark. 
Seeking only truth within, unconcerned with outcomes, you showed everyone what a real hero looks like. 
 The world has not failed you. You saw the smiles and tears beneath the masks, the faint glimmers of humanity that still remain...

Just as the Trailblaze basks in starlight, and starts the journey anew from this land.
story.title: Your "Story": Part V

Thirteen heartbeats sing proudly for the Flame-Chase Journey, for that was the land they deeply cherished.
The first page of the story unfolds once more, inscribed with prophecies of life.

Listen! The wind sings a melody, the Seeds of Memory grow among the stars, for
the cosmos now knows the name, "Amphoreus."
story.title: Your "Story": Part IV

story.text:
You're a hero from beyond, an idol pursued by the masses. 
 Some want to put you on a pedestal, while others wait with bated breath for your fall. 
 The minute you step into this world, you become the center of attention.

You've been thrust into a game. 
 In a time when traffic means everything, spectacle after spectacle unfolds, each vying for more eyes. 
 In the end, heroes and clowns are viewed the same, and tragedies are not that different from comedies.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on? 
 The dice of destiny now rest in your palm. To wear the mask or cast it aside? The choice is always yours.

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain. 
 You raise your glow stick like a torch held high. 
 To stand at the center of the cosmos, one must possess the power to command the storm.

When met with malice, you still create wishes of kindness. 
 Without praise, you light your own way through the dark. 
Seeking only truth within, unconcerned with outcomes, you showed everyone what a real hero looks like. 
 The world has not failed you. You saw the smiles and tears beneath the masks, the faint glimmers of humanity that still remain...

Just as the Trailblaze basks in starlight, and starts the journey anew from this land.
story.title: Your "Story": Part V
